title: Transportation Law's Congestion Problem

detail.title: Transportation Law's Congestion Problem

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-05
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Law School Public Law Research Paper No. 2026-05
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Transportation law has a congestion problem: our federalist system of government allows federal and state actors to stymie innovative, locally driven projects that aim to reduce driving. This problem is illustrated in the decades-long legal battles over New York City’s plan to impose “congestion pricing” to toll drivers entering certain parts of Manhattan. Overcoming grandstanding elected officials, lawsuits resting on state and federal supremacy, and even a federal legislative override, congestion pricing was finally launched in January 2025. New Yorkers and suburbanites alike almost immediately started benefiting from cleaner air, faster commutes, safer roads, and increased economic activity and productivity—plus boatloads of money for transit improvements. Just six weeks later, however, the Trump administration Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy announced he was unilaterally rescinding federal approval for the program, once again throwing it into legal limbo.

Through the lens of congestion pricing and its unique characteristics, this Essay illustrates the relatively limited power of local and regional authorities to advance innovative transportation initiatives through the federal and state permitting gauntlet. Part I relates the congestion-pricing backstory in New York City from its origins in the late nineteenth century, to federal and state officials’ unwelcome intervention at key points, to its approval last year. Part II covers the latest attempt to roll back congestion pricing and the pending case of Metropolitan Transportation Authority v. Duffy, a federal lawsuit filed against Secretary Duffy by the regional body that operates the New York City congestion pricing program. Part III argues that new legal approaches that safeguard local interests are necessary. It identifies several judicial and congressional measures that may afford local governments more latitude to plan and carry out their transportation priorities and that may offer innovative, decarbonizing projects a higher priority in permitting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过纽约市拥堵收费计划的案例，分析了联邦制下地方政府在推进创新交通项目时面临的障碍，并提出了保护地方利益的法律改革方案。
AI.research_question: 在联邦制政府体系下，地方政府如何能够克服联邦和州级干预，有效推进创新性交通项目（如拥堵收费）？
AI.motivation: 交通法存在"拥堵问题"：联邦制体系允许联邦和州级行为体阻碍旨在减少驾驶的创新性地方项目。纽约市拥堵收费计划长达数十年的法律斗争说明了这一问题，尽管最终实施并带来了显著效益，但联邦政府仍能单方面撤销批准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦主义理论、地方自治权理论、环境政策执行理论、交通规划与治理理论
AI.method: 案例研究法：以纽约市拥堵收费计划为案例，分析其历史发展、法律挑战和实施过程；法律分析法：分析相关法律框架和司法途径
AI.findings: 1. 地方政府在推进创新交通项目时权力相对有限；2. 联邦和州级政府能够通过多种方式阻碍地方项目；3. 即使项目成功实施并带来效益，仍可能被上级政府单方面撤销；4. 现有法律框架未能充分保护地方利益
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对联邦制下地方政府权力限制的理解；2. 提出了交通政策创新与地方自治权之间的理论张力；3. 为环境政策执行理论提供了实证案例
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 识别了保护地方利益的司法和立法措施；2. 提出了给予地方政府更多规划自主权的改革方案；3. 建议在审批过程中优先考虑创新性减碳项目；4. 为其他城市推进类似项目提供了法律策略参考

title: Credit Allocation under Physical and Transition Climate Risks

detail.title: Credit Allocation under Physical and Transition Climate Risks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have no relevant or material research support and financial interests/conflicts that relate to the research described in this paper.

detail.abstract: This paper studies how banks adjust credit allocation in response to firms' exposure to climate-related physical and transition risks, with a focus on non-listed SMEs. Using granular firm-level measures of both risk types matched to a universal bankfirm credit dataset from Danish administrative registers, I document that banks reduce credit growth to firms with higher exposure to either risk. A one standard deviation increase in physical (transition) risk is associated with a 1.1-1.4% (1.6-2.2%) decline in loan growth. Beyond average effects, I find evidence of credit reallocation across firms with heterogeneous risk profiles: more credit is allocated to firms with low joint exposure to physical and transition risks and to high-risk firms that engage in greening activities. Credit contractions are strongest when climate risks compound existing borrower vulnerabilities, such as financial constraints and asset exposure, and among banks with higher climate risk exposure and repeat lending relationships. Mechanism tests indicate that banks' credit risk considerations play an important role in driving these credit responses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了银行如何根据企业对气候相关物理风险和转型风险的暴露程度调整信贷分配，重点关注非上市中小企业。研究发现银行会减少对高风险企业的信贷增长，同时进行跨企业的信贷再分配，将更多信贷分配给低风险企业和从事绿色活动的高风险企业。
AI.research_question: 银行如何根据企业对气候相关物理风险和转型风险的暴露程度调整信贷分配？这种调整在不同风险特征的企业之间是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化加剧，气候相关风险对金融稳定和企业融资的影响日益重要。然而，银行如何应对不同类型的气候风险，特别是对非上市中小企业的信贷分配调整机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信贷风险理论，银行信贷决策受借款人风险暴露影响。结合气候风险文献，区分物理风险（极端天气事件）和转型风险（低碳转型政策）对信贷分配的影响。
AI.method: 使用丹麦行政登记数据构建企业级气候风险指标，匹配银行-企业信贷数据集。采用计量经济学方法分析风险暴露与信贷增长的关系，并进行机制检验。
AI.findings: 1. 银行减少对高风险企业的信贷增长：物理风险增加一个标准差导致贷款增长下降1.1-1.4%，转型风险增加一个标准差导致下降1.6-2.2%。2. 信贷再分配：更多信贷分配给低联合风险企业和从事绿色活动的高风险企业。3. 信贷收缩在借款人已有脆弱性（财务约束、资产暴露）和银行自身风险暴露较高时最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统区分物理风险和转型风险对银行信贷决策的影响。2. 揭示银行在气候风险下的信贷再分配机制。3. 扩展信贷风险理论，纳入气候风险维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行气候风险管理提供实证依据。2. 为企业应对气候风险融资提供指导。3. 为监管机构制定气候相关金融政策提供参考。

title: Memory Shapes Reaction to Extreme Returns in Stock Sale Decisions
affiliations: University of Warwick - Department of Statistics,  and University of Warwick

detail.title: Memory Shapes Reaction to Extreme Returns in Stock Sale Decisions
detail.abstract: We provide empirical evidence on how selective memory shapes the propensity for an investor to realize the sale of stocks in their portfolio after observing extreme stock and market returns. It is well known that investors are more likely to sell stocks that had a large return on the previous day. We observe that investor reactions to such extreme events, or cues, are significantly affected by their own past realized returns. Investors whose best past realized returns were higher, tend to react less to an extreme positive stock or market return. Those with lower worst past realized returns tend to react more to extreme negative stock or market returns. The impact of the memories of the worst realized returns on the propensity to sell is greater, the more recently those worst returns were experienced. We also find that memory effects are stronger for more attentive and sophisticated investors. Our empirical findings are consistent with the principles of selective memory, a process of memory retrieval guided by similarity, which influences belief formation. Our results also demonstrate a positive memory bias.

AI.tldr: 投资者对极端市场波动的反应受到其过往已实现收益记忆的影响，特别是最差收益的记忆对卖出决策影响更大，且近期记忆效应更强。
AI.research_question: 选择性记忆如何影响投资者在观察到极端股票和市场收益后的卖出倾向？
AI.motivation: 已知投资者更可能卖出前一天有大幅收益的股票，但投资者自身过往已实现收益的记忆如何调节这种反应尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选择性记忆理论（基于相似性的记忆检索过程影响信念形成）和积极记忆偏差。
AI.method: 实证研究，分析投资者对极端收益事件的反应与其过往已实现收益记忆的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 过往最佳收益较高的投资者对极端正收益反应较弱；2. 过往最差收益较低的投资者对极端负收益反应较强；3. 最差收益记忆越近期，对卖出倾向影响越大；4. 记忆效应对更专注和成熟的投资者更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 为选择性记忆理论在金融决策中的应用提供实证支持，验证了积极记忆偏差的存在。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者认识记忆偏差对投资决策的影响，为投资顾问提供行为金融学洞见以改善客户决策。

title: From Product to Infrastructure Reframing Physical Environments in Early Childhood Institutions

detail.title: From Product to Infrastructure Reframing Physical Environments in Early Childhood Institutions
detail.abstract: This paper argues that certain physical environments used in early childhood institutions are systematically misclassified as discretionary products rather than institutional infrastructure. This classification error is not semantic. It shapes how such environments are designed, procured, governed, and maintained. And, it materially affects how responsibility for developmental conditions is allocated.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为，早期儿童教育机构中的某些物理环境被系统性地错误分类为可自由支配的产品而非机构基础设施。这种分类错误不仅具有语义影响，还塑造了这些环境的设计、采购、治理和维护方式，并实质性地影响了发展条件责任的分配。
AI.research_question: 为什么早期儿童教育机构的物理环境被错误分类为可自由支配的产品而非基础设施？这种错误分类如何影响这些环境的设计、采购、治理和维护，以及如何影响发展条件的责任分配？
AI.motivation: 早期儿童教育机构的物理环境对儿童发展至关重要，但当前对这些环境的分类存在系统性错误，将其视为可自由支配的产品而非基础设施，这导致了设计、采购、治理和维护方面的不当实践，并影响了责任分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、基础设施理论、分类理论、责任分配理论
AI.method: 概念分析、制度分析、分类分析、案例研究
AI.findings: 早期儿童教育机构的物理环境被系统性地错误分类为可自由支配产品，这种分类错误具有实质性影响：它塑造了环境的设计、采购、治理和维护方式，并影响了发展条件责任的分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了早期儿童教育机构物理环境的分类理论框架；2) 揭示了分类错误如何通过制度机制影响实践；3) 发展了基础设施与责任分配的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供重新分类早期儿童教育环境的依据；2) 为机构管理者改进设计、采购和治理实践提供指导；3) 为责任分配机制改革提供建议。

title: "Beyond the Language Barrier: Digital Divides and Environmental Participation in Immigrant Communities"
affiliations: Faculty of Environmental and Urban Change, York University

detail.title: "Beyond the Language Barrier: Digital Divides and Environmental Participation in Immigrant Communities"
detail.abstract: Municipal environmental communication strategies increasingly rely on digital platforms, yet these approaches may systematically exclude immigrant communities who face cultural, linguistic, and technological barriers to accessing environmental information. This study examines communication barriers among first-generation immigrants in the Greater Toronto Area through a cross-sectional survey of 815 participants across four age cohorts, measuring English proficiency, digital literacy, and municipal resource awareness. Results reveal substantial disparities in communication accessibility that intensify dramatically with age. English proficiency declined from 73.4% among participants aged 18-35 to 36.8% among those 65+, while digital literacy barriers compounded these challenges, with only 12.4% of older participants comfortable navigating government websites. Municipal resource awareness showed the steepest decline, falling from 59.8% to 5.6% across age groups. Nearly one-quarter of participants (22.3%) faced all three barrier types simultaneously, with environmental program participation rates of only 8.2% among this group compared to 76.4% among those facing no barriers. Analysis revealed that barriers compound each other's effects rather than simply adding together, with communication factors explaining over one-third of participation differences beyond basic demographics. Despite facing multiple communication barriers, 78.9% of participants expressed strong interest in environmental programs when information was made accessible, creating substantial gaps between environmental interest and actual participation across all program types. These findings demonstrate systematic environmental communication exclusion that we term "digital environmental injustice." The results indicate that addressing communication barriers, rather than assuming lack of environmental concern, represents the key opportunity for improving program effectiveness. Recommendations include maintaining non-digital communication options alongside digital improvements, prioritizing multilingual approaches, and partnering with trusted community organizations to ensure equitable environmental participation.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现多伦多地区移民社区在获取市政环境信息时面临语言、数字素养和资源认知三重障碍，这些障碍随年龄加剧并相互叠加，导致"数字环境不公"现象。尽管移民对环境项目有浓厚兴趣，但沟通障碍严重阻碍了实际参与。
AI.research_question: 移民社区在获取市政环境信息时面临哪些沟通障碍？这些障碍如何影响他们参与环境项目？
AI.motivation: 市政环境沟通日益依赖数字平台，但可能系统性地排除面临文化、语言和技术障碍的移民社区，导致环境参与不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字环境不公、沟通障碍理论、环境正义理论、数字鸿沟理论
AI.method: 对大多伦多地区815名第一代移民进行横断面调查，测量英语熟练度、数字素养和市政资源认知，分析四个年龄组的数据。
AI.findings: 沟通障碍随年龄急剧加剧：英语熟练度从18-35岁的73.4%降至65岁以上的36.8%；数字素养障碍更严重，仅12.4%的老年人能自如使用政府网站；市政资源认知从59.8%降至5.6%。22.3%的参与者同时面临三重障碍，其环境项目参与率仅8.2%，而无障碍者参与率达76.4%。障碍相互叠加而非简单相加，沟通因素解释了超过三分之一的人口统计学差异外的参与差异。尽管面临多重障碍，78.9%的参与者表示当信息可获取时对环境项目有浓厚兴趣。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"数字环境不公"概念，揭示了沟通障碍如何系统性地排除移民社区参与环境项目；展示了障碍的叠加效应而非简单相加；挑战了"缺乏环境关注"的假设，强调沟通可及性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议在数字改进的同时保留非数字沟通选项；优先采用多语言方法；与可信赖的社区组织合作；将解决沟通障碍而非假设缺乏关注作为提高项目有效性的关键策略。

title: Income-Based Policies for Public Electric Vehicle Charging Station Deployment
affiliations: and ETH Zürich

detail.title: Income-Based Policies for Public Electric Vehicle Charging Station Deployment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors would like to thank SafeGraph for providing the mobility data. S. Powell gratefully acknowledges support from an ETH Postdoctoral Fellowship and an Ambizione Grant from the Swiss National Science Foundation. Marie-Louise Arlt gratefully acknowledges funding received from the European Union’s Framework Programme for Research and Innovation Horizon 2020 (2014-2020) under the Marie Sklodowska-Curie Grant Arrangement No. 754388 (LMUResearch-Fellows) and from LMUexcellent, funded by the Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) and the Free State of Bavaria under the Excellence Strategy of the German Federal Government and the Länder. The authors would like to thank many collaborators and members of their labs for their support and helpful discussions of this work.

detail.abstract: Widespread electric vehicle use is a key step to tackling transportation emissions, but adoption has yet to take off beyond high-income communities. A lack of access to public charging stations can be a major barrier to adoption. In this paper, we analyze the distribution and typology of public charging stations found in low-, mid-, and high-income communities across the US. Our results identify a robust neighborhood advantage, where high income in the surrounding area coincides with higher numbers of public stations in lower income block groups. We further show that station types in lower income areas are associated with shorter stops, suggesting they are designed to serve pass-through demand. Future income-based policies for public charging infrastructure should consider how new stations fit local residents' mobility patterns and should use both local and neighborhood income to better target their support toward equal access for all future electric vehicle drivers.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国不同收入社区公共充电站的分布和类型，发现高收入周边地区会给低收入街区带来"邻里优势"，但低收入地区的充电站类型更适合短暂停留，而非居民日常使用。
AI.research_question: 美国不同收入社区（低收入、中等收入、高收入）的公共充电站分布和类型有何差异？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车普及是减少交通排放的关键，但除高收入社区外，普及率仍然有限。缺乏公共充电站可能是采用的主要障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于邻里效应和环境正义理论，探讨基础设施分布中的社会经济不平等问题。
AI.method: 分析美国不同收入社区（低收入、中等收入、高收入）公共充电站的分布和类型学特征。
AI.findings: 1. 发现"邻里优势"现象：高收入周边地区与低收入街区中更多公共充电站相关；2. 低收入地区的充电站类型与较短停留时间相关，表明这些站点主要为过路需求设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了基础设施分布不平等的理论理解，特别是"邻里优势"概念，揭示了周边高收入如何影响低收入地区的基础设施可获得性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议未来基于收入的政策应考虑新充电站如何适应当地居民出行模式，并同时使用本地和邻里收入数据，以更好地支持所有未来电动汽车驾驶员的平等获取。

reference: SAFE Working Paper No. 466
title: Multimodal LLMs for Historical Dataset Construction from Archival Image Scans: German Patents (1877–1918)
affiliations: University of Mannheim and University of Mannheim

detail.title: Multimodal LLMs for Historical Dataset Construction from Archival Image Scans: German Patents (1877–1918)

publicationDetails.journalName: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We leverage multimodal large language models (LLMs) to construct a dataset of 306,070 German patents (1877-1918) from 9,562 archival image scans using our LLM-based pipeline powered by Gemini-2.5-Pro and Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite. Our benchmarking exercise provides tentative evidence that multimodal LLMs can create higher quality datasets than our research assistants, while also being more than 795 times faster and 205 times cheaper in constructing the patent dataset from our image corpus. About 20 to 50 patent entries are embedded on each page, arranged in a double-column format and printed in Gothic and Roman fonts. The font and layout complexity of our primary source material suggests to us that multimodal LLMs are a paradigm shift in how datasets are constructed in economic history. We open-source our benchmarking and patent datasets as well as our LLM-based data pipeline, which can be easily adapted to other image corpora using LLM-assisted coding tools, lowering the barriers for less technical researchers. Finally, we explain the economics of deploying LLMs for historical dataset construction and conclude by speculating on the potential implications for the field of economic history.

AI.tldr: 本文利用多模态大语言模型（LLM）从9,562张档案图像扫描中构建了306,070个德国专利（1877-1918年）的数据集，证明了多模态LLM在数据构建质量、速度和成本方面远超人工研究助理。
AI.research_question: 多模态大语言模型能否有效构建历史数据集，并在质量、速度和成本方面优于传统人工方法？
AI.motivation: 历史档案材料（如专利文件）通常以复杂格式（哥特体和罗马体字体、双栏排版）存在，传统人工提取方法耗时耗力且成本高昂，需要更高效的数据构建方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态大语言模型理论、历史数据数字化理论、经济史研究方法论
AI.method: 使用Gemini-2.5-Pro和Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite多模态LLM构建数据管道，从9,562张档案图像扫描中提取专利信息，并与人工研究助理进行基准测试比较。
AI.findings: 多模态LLM构建的数据集质量高于人工研究助理，速度提升795倍以上，成本降低205倍，能够有效处理复杂字体和排版的历史文档。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多模态LLM在历史数据构建中的范式转变理论，为经济史研究方法论提供了新的技术路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 开源了基准测试和专利数据集以及LLM数据管道，降低了非技术研究人员的门槛，提供了LLM部署的经济学分析，对经济史领域具有重要实践意义。

title: The Stagnation Paradox: A Longitudinal Analysis of Structural Limitations in Canadian Extended Producer Responsibility Programs
affiliations: Faculty of Environmental and Urban Change, York University

detail.title: The Stagnation Paradox: A Longitudinal Analysis of Structural Limitations in Canadian Extended Producer Responsibility Programs
detail.abstract:
Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) has emerged as a dominant policy instrument intended to internalize environmental externalities and drive the transition toward a circular economy. However, a longitudinal analysis of Canada's primary EPR jurisdictions—British Columbia, Ontario, Manitoba, and Quebec—reveals a systemic divergence between theoretical promise and empirical reality, characterized as a "stagnation paradox". Utilizing primary financial and operational data from annual stewardship reports, this study documents a trajectory of "escalating costs" and "stagnant returns" within mature recycling systems.

Key empirical findings demonstrate that exponential increases in financial inputs have failed to generate proportionate environmental improvements. In British Columbia, program costs surged by 250% between 2014 and 2023, yet the material recovery rate remained statistically flat. Similarly, Ontario's net system costs nearly tripled over an eighteen-year period, while recovery rates regressed to 53.3%, a figure virtually identical to the baseline recorded nearly two decades prior. The analysis identifies the "evolving tonne"—the shift toward lightweight, complex, and multi-laminate plastics—as a critical structural barrier that renders mechanical recycling infrastructure increasingly inefficient.

Furthermore, the study challenges the economic assumptions of EPR, presenting evidence that compliance costs are passed through to consumers rather than absorbed by producers, thereby functioning as a regressive tax on households. Ultimately, the data suggests that without addressing the disconnect between packaging innovation and waste management infrastructure, EPR risks functioning solely as a mechanism for cost redistribution rather than a driver of environmental performance.

AI.tldr: 加拿大主要EPR管辖区（BC省、安大略省、曼尼托巴省、魁北克省）的纵向分析显示，生产者责任延伸制度存在"停滞悖论"：成本急剧上升但回收率停滞不前，EPR更多成为成本再分配机制而非环境绩效驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 生产者责任延伸制度（EPR）在加拿大主要管辖区实施的实际效果如何？为什么EPR的理论承诺与实际结果之间存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: EPR作为推动循环经济转型的主要政策工具，理论上应能内化环境外部性，但需要实证检验其实际效果，特别是成本效益和环境绩效之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产者责任延伸理论、循环经济理论、环境外部性内化理论、政策实施与效果评估框架。
AI.method: 纵向分析，使用加拿大四个主要EPR管辖区（BC省、安大略省、曼尼托巴省、魁北克省）的年度管理报告中的主要财务和运营数据进行实证研究。
AI.findings: 1. 成本急剧上升但回收率停滞（"停滞悖论"）；2. BC省2014-2023年成本增长250%，回收率无显著改善；3. 安大略省18年间系统成本几乎翻三倍，回收率倒退至53.3%；4. "演变吨位"（轻量化、复杂多层塑料）成为结构性障碍；5. 合规成本转嫁给消费者而非生产者承担。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"停滞悖论"概念，解释EPR理论与实践的差距；2. 识别"演变吨位"作为关键结构性障碍；3. 挑战EPR的经济假设，揭示其作为累退税而非环境绩效驱动因素的本质。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供实证依据，说明当前EPR实施的局限性；2. 指出需要解决包装创新与废物管理基础设施之间的脱节问题；3. 建议重新设计EPR政策，使其真正成为环境绩效驱动因素而非成本再分配机制。

title: Regularized Wishart Stochastic Volatility for High-Dimensional Covariance Forecasting
affiliations: University of Cologne, Department of Economics, Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina (UFSC) and University of Cologne, Germany

detail.title: Regularized Wishart Stochastic Volatility for High-Dimensional Covariance Forecasting

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors report there are no competing interests to declare.

detail.abstract: We extend Uhlig's (1994, 1997)Wishart stochastic volatility (WSV) model by introducing a regularized state transition for the precision matrix that shrinks the covariance forecasts toward a  prior reference matrix. This regularization ensures stationarity of the return process and stabilizes the eigenvalues of the covariance forecasts, while preserving closed-form expressions for filtering, prediction, and likelihood evaluation. We provide conditions for stationarity and for the existence of second- and fourth-order moments, show that the model admits a multivariate GARCH representation, and derive bounds that illustrate how regularization prevents degeneracy and excessive dispersion in the eigenvalues of the covariance matrix forecasts. To account for regime shifts in the correlation structure, we further embed a time-varying directional forgetting scheme into the regularized model, allowing the forgetting rate to differ over time and across directions in the return space. In a high-dimensional application with up to 1,000 assets, the regularized models deliver significantly more accurate covariance forecasts than the baseline WSV and perform well compared to several benchmark models.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Uhlig的Wishart随机波动率模型，通过引入正则化的状态转移来收缩协方差预测至先验参考矩阵，确保收益率过程的平稳性并稳定协方差预测的特征值，同时保持滤波、预测和似然评估的闭式表达式。
AI.research_question: 如何在Wishart随机波动率模型中引入正则化机制来改善高维资产协方差矩阵的预测准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统Wishart随机波动率模型在高维应用中可能产生不稳定的协方差预测，特征值可能过度分散或退化，需要正则化机制来改善预测性能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Uhlig的Wishart随机波动率模型，引入正则化状态转移机制，将协方差预测收缩至先验参考矩阵，确保平稳性和特征值稳定性。
AI.method: 扩展Wishart随机波动率模型，引入正则化状态转移；推导平稳性条件、二阶和四阶矩存在条件；建立多元GARCH表示；嵌入时变方向性遗忘方案以处理相关结构中的制度转换。
AI.findings: 正则化模型确保收益率过程平稳性，稳定协方差预测特征值，防止退化和过度分散；在高达1000个资产的高维应用中，正则化模型比基准WSV模型提供显著更准确的协方差预测，且优于多个基准模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展WSV模型的正则化框架；2) 推导平稳性条件和矩存在条件；3) 建立多元GARCH表示；4) 提供防止特征值退化和过度分散的理论界限；5) 引入时变方向性遗忘方案处理制度转换。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为高维资产协方差预测提供实用工具；2) 保持闭式表达式便于计算；3) 在高达1000个资产的实际应用中展示优越的预测性能；4) 为风险管理、资产配置等金融应用提供改进的协方差估计。

detail.title: Crispr-Based In Vivo Gene Editing For Rare And Previously Untreatable Diseases

detail.abstract: Rare genetic diseases collectively affect millions worldwide, yet most remain without effective treatments due to the diversity and complexity of causative mutations. The advent of CRISPR-based in vivo gene editing has ushered in a new era of therapeutic potential, enabling direct correction of disease-causing genetic variants within patient tissues. This paper reviews recent advances in CRISPR delivery systems, therapeutic strategies, clinical successes, ethical considerations, and challenges in translating in vivo gene editing into safe and accessible therapies for rare and previously untreatable diseases. We highlight preclinical and clinical examples, discuss safety and efficacy concerns, and propose future directions for the field.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了CRISPR体内基因编辑在罕见遗传病治疗中的最新进展，包括递送系统、治疗策略、临床成功案例、伦理考量及转化挑战，旨在推动这一领域向安全可及的疗法发展。
AI.research_question: 如何将CRISPR体内基因编辑技术转化为安全、有效的罕见遗传病治疗方法？
AI.motivation: 罕见遗传病影响全球数百万人，但由于致病突变的多样性和复杂性，大多数疾病缺乏有效治疗方法。CRISPR体内基因编辑技术为直接纠正患者组织中的致病基因变异提供了新的治疗潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CRISPR-Cas系统的基因编辑理论，包括基因敲除、基因校正、基因插入等策略；药物递送系统理论；罕见遗传病的分子病理学基础。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统回顾和分析CRISPR体内基因编辑领域的最新研究进展、临床前和临床案例、递送系统开发、安全性和有效性数据。
AI.findings: CRISPR体内基因编辑在多种罕见遗传病的临床前和临床试验中显示出治疗潜力；递送系统（如病毒载体、脂质纳米颗粒）的改进提高了靶向性和安全性；但仍存在脱靶效应、免疫反应、长期安全性等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了CRISPR体内基因编辑治疗罕见遗传病的理论框架，整合了递送系统、编辑策略和疾病模型的相互关系，为未来研究提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 总结了当前临床成功案例和最佳实践，提出了解决安全性和可及性挑战的具体方向，为研究人员、临床医生和监管机构提供了转化医学的实用指南。

detail.abstract: The Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) is a nationally representative longitudinal study of families and individuals that began in 1968. The initial focus of the PSID was to examine dynamics of employment, earnings, and income over the life cycle through interviews with roughly 5,000 families. The PSID continues to interview many of these same families today, as well as their descendents. Although the PSID has always had a high response rate of 94-98 percent between each wave, cumulative non-response over the 39-year period is substantial. Moreover, several changes have been implemented to the PSID since the mid-1990s.

AI.tldr: PSID是一项始于1968年的全国家庭和个人纵向研究，虽然每波调查响应率高达94-98%，但39年累积无响应问题严重，且自1990年代中期以来进行了多项改革。
AI.research_question: PSID长期纵向研究中的累积无响应问题及其对数据质量的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: PSID作为重要的纵向研究数据源，虽然单波响应率很高，但长期累积的无响应可能影响数据代表性和研究结论的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 纵向研究设计理论、样本流失偏差理论、数据质量评估框架
AI.method: 对PSID 39年纵向数据的响应率分析，包括每波响应率和累积响应率的计算与比较
AI.findings: PSID每波调查响应率高达94-98%，但39年累积无响应问题严重，可能影响数据的长期代表性
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了纵向研究中即使单波高响应率也可能存在严重的累积样本流失问题，为纵向研究设计提供了重要警示
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者在使用PSID等长期纵向数据时需要注意累积无响应问题，建议采用适当的方法校正样本偏差

detail.abstract: A set of questions on wealth transfers was added to Wave 35 of the core Panel Study of Income Dynamics in 2007 with support from the National Institute on Aging (PI: Stafford, Project 5 of P01 P01AG029409). The questions in the 2007 module built on research conducted by John Laitner and F. Thomas Juster on TIAA‐CREF annuitants (Laitner and Juster, 1996) and used some of the same questions that were originally asked in the 1988 PSID Time and Money Transfer Module. The 2007 PSID question series consisted of 2 ½ minutes of content in three domains: 1) ratings of the importance of bequests across various sources, 2) ratings of the future earnings expectations of children, and 3) actual and expected transfers to parents and parents‐in‐law in the forms of financial support, caregiving, shared housing o parents and parents‐in‐law, and expectations about the provision of such future support. The appendix lists the questions asked in this module. The goal of this brief report is to provide the scientific user community with information on quality of the data obtained in the module and basic information about the distribution of responses in the total sample and by key socio‐demographic characteristics.

AI.research_question: 2007年PSID财富转移模块收集的数据质量如何？不同社会经济特征群体的财富转移行为和态度分布情况是怎样的？

title: Geometric Analysis of Implied Volatility in Options

detail.title: Geometric Analysis of Implied Volatility in Options

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This paper proposes an internal decomposition of implied volatility, introducing a geometric and economically interpretable framework to analyze the structure and dynamics of the volatility skew. The implied volatility surface is modeled as a continuous equilibrium system, whose shape reflects the interaction of market forces across strikes and maturities.

We introduce the K-EVA framework (Kinetic Equilibrium Volatility Adjustment), which unifies the local volatility approach of Dupire (1994) and the SVI/eSSVI parametrizations (Gatheral, 2004–2016) within a single, arbitrage-consistent representation. Unlike standard approaches focused on functional fitting, K-EVA explicitly decomposes the surface into structural components governing curvature, displacement, level, and asymmetry.

The resulting parameters are stable, dimensionless, and comparable across assets and market regimes. Empirical evidence from liquid Brazilian equity options shows that the proposed decomposition delivers greater geometric consistency and robustness than conventional parametrizations, particularly during stress periods. The framework provides practical tools for mark-to-market, risk diagnostics, and volatility-based hedging strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个隐含波动率的内部分解框架K-EVA，将波动率曲面建模为连续均衡系统，通过几何和经济可解释的参数分解曲面结构，比传统参数化方法更稳定、更具可比性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个几何和经济可解释的框架来分解和分析隐含波动率曲面的结构和动态？
AI.motivation: 传统隐含波动率参数化方法主要关注函数拟合，缺乏经济解释性和结构稳定性，特别是在市场压力时期表现不佳。需要一种能够统一局部波动率方法和SVI/eSSVI参数化、具有经济可解释性的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: K-EVA（Kinetic Equilibrium Volatility Adjustment）框架，将隐含波动率曲面建模为连续均衡系统，统一了Dupire（1994）的局部波动率方法和Gatheral（2004-2016）的SVI/eSSVI参数化方法。
AI.method: 提出几何和经济可解释的参数分解方法，将波动率曲面分解为控制曲率、位移、水平和不对称性的结构成分。使用巴西流动性股票期权数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: K-EVA框架的参数具有稳定性、无量纲性和跨资产/市场机制的可比性。在压力时期比传统参数化方法表现出更好的几何一致性和鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了将波动率曲面作为连续均衡系统建模的新理论框架；2）统一了局部波动率和SVI/eSSVI方法；3）提供了具有经济解释性的结构分解方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为盯市估值提供实用工具；2）改进风险诊断能力；3）支持基于波动率的对冲策略；4）参数具有跨资产可比性，便于风险管理。

title: Import-Export Trends of Bangladesh and Their Impact on GDP Growth (1972-2024)

detail.title: Import-Export Trends of Bangladesh and Their Impact on GDP Growth (1972-2024)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest or financial relationships that could have influenced the conduct or findings of this study.

detail.abstract: Examining the trends in imports, exports, and GDP growth in Bangladesh from 1972 to 2024, spanning from post-independence recovery to recent global challenges. Utilizing annual timeseries data from the World Bank World Development Indicators, Bangladesh Bank, and Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics, the study applies descriptive statistics, trend analysis, correlation, and simple linear regression to assess relationships. Findings indicate weak positive correlations between export growth and GDP growth (r = 0.12) and import growth and GDP growth (r = 0.10), with an export-import correlation of 0.36. The regression model (GDP growth = 4.45 + 0.016 Export growth + 0.009 Import growth, R² = 0.019) is insignificant (p = 0.625), suggesting trade growth has a limited direct impact on GDP over the full period, though post-1990 trends show stronger links due to RMG sector expansion. Average GDP growth was 4.65%, exports 9.57%, and imports 6.27%, with volatility in early years and recent slowdowns (e.g., 2020 pandemic). The trade-to-GDP ratio rose from around 13% in the 1970s to 33% in the 2020s, reflecting increased openness but persistent deficits. The economy's susceptibility to shocks underscores the need for export diversification, import management, and complementary policies like remittance and FDI enhancement. This analysis addresses gaps in long-term studies, emphasizing nuanced trade-GDP dynamics beyond export-led growth narratives.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了1972-2024年孟加拉国的进出口与GDP增长关系，发现贸易增长对GDP的直接影响有限，但1990年后因成衣业扩张而增强。贸易开放度上升但赤字持续，需多元化出口和管理进口。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国1972-2024年期间进出口增长与GDP增长之间的关系如何？贸易开放度如何变化？
AI.motivation: 填补长期研究的空白，超越简单的出口导向增长叙事，深入理解孟加拉国贸易与GDP关系的动态变化，特别是从独立后恢复期到近期全球挑战的演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 出口导向增长理论、贸易开放与经济增长关系理论、结构转型理论（特别是成衣业扩张的影响）。
AI.method: 使用世界银行世界发展指标、孟加拉国央行和统计局的时间序列数据，采用描述性统计、趋势分析、相关分析和简单线性回归。
AI.findings: 1. 出口增长与GDP增长呈弱正相关(r=0.12)，进口增长与GDP增长呈弱正相关(r=0.10)；2. 回归模型不显著(p=0.625)，R²=0.019；3. 1990年后因成衣业扩张关系增强；4. 贸易占GDP比率从13%升至33%；5. 经济易受冲击，需政策支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了简单的出口导向增长叙事；2. 揭示了贸易与GDP关系的阶段性特征；3. 强调了结构转型（成衣业）在调节贸易-增长关系中的作用；4. 提供了长期时间序列分析的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供出口多元化建议；2. 强调进口管理的重要性；3. 指出需要补充政策如汇款和FDI促进；4. 帮助理解经济对冲击的脆弱性；5. 为长期发展战略提供实证依据。

title: Business Law in Georgia: Courts, Arbitration, Mediation, and Insolvency as Instruments of Commercial Dispute Management in a Transitional Jurisdiction

detail.title: Business Law in Georgia: Courts, Arbitration, Mediation, and Insolvency as Instruments of Commercial Dispute Management in a Transitional Jurisdiction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants and therefore does not require ethics approval
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Georgia is frequently characterized as a business-friendly jurisdiction due to the procedural simplicity of company registration and comparatively liberal economic regulation. However, the true stability of a business environment is determined not by entry formalities, but by the quality and coherence of its dispute resolution mechanisms. This paper examines the system of commercial dispute management in Georgia, focusing on judicial proceedings, arbitration, mediation, corporate reorganization, and insolvency. The analysis demonstrates that these mechanisms serve distinct legal functions and should be understood as components of a broader dispute management architecture rather than as interchangeable remedies. By situating Georgian business law within a comparative and functional framework, the article highlights the structural factors that contribute to its practical attractiveness in a transitional legal system.

AI.tldr: 本文分析格鲁吉亚商业纠纷解决机制，指出虽然公司注册程序简单，但商业环境的真正稳定性取决于纠纷解决机制的质量和连贯性。文章将司法程序、仲裁、调解、公司重组和破产视为不同法律功能的组成部分，而非可互换的救济方式。
AI.research_question: 格鲁吉亚商业纠纷解决机制（司法程序、仲裁、调解、公司重组和破产）如何构成一个整体的纠纷管理架构，以及这些机制在过渡性法律体系中的实际吸引力如何？
AI.motivation: 虽然格鲁吉亚因公司注册程序简单而被认为是商业友好型司法管辖区，但商业环境的真正稳定性取决于纠纷解决机制的质量和连贯性，而非仅仅是进入手续的便利性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较法和功能主义框架，将商业纠纷解决机制视为具有不同法律功能的组成部分，而非可互换的救济方式。
AI.method: 对格鲁吉亚商业纠纷管理系统进行系统性分析，包括司法程序、仲裁、调解、公司重组和破产机制，采用比较法和功能主义分析方法。
AI.findings: 格鲁吉亚的各种商业纠纷解决机制服务于不同的法律功能，应被视为更广泛的纠纷管理架构的组成部分。在过渡性法律体系中，这些结构性因素共同构成了其实际吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将商业纠纷解决机制视为具有不同功能的架构性组成部分的理论视角，而非简单的替代性救济方式，为理解过渡性法律体系的商业环境提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了对格鲁吉亚商业纠纷解决系统的全面理解，有助于评估商业环境的实际稳定性，并为其他过渡性经济体的法律改革提供参考。

title: From Individual Responsibility to Organizational Environment Optimization: A Paradigmatic Transition Toward Post-Neoliberal Organizational Theory

detail.title: From Individual Responsibility to Organizational Environment Optimization: A Paradigmatic Transition Toward Post-Neoliberal Organizational Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the CEO of HOWAR Srl

detail.abstract: This foundational paper introduces the core concepts that inform a broader program of theoretical development in organizational science. Drawing on years of applied experience and preliminary literature review, we propose a paradigmatic transition from approaches centered on individual responsibility toward systematic optimization of organizational environments. We introduce the HOWAR© Formula C = f(I,A) as a new conceptual foundation, establishing the basis for understanding organizational behavior through the dynamic interaction between individual Identity (I) and organizational Ambient environment (A). The paper presents the critical distinction between organizational climate (subjective perceptions) and organizational environment (objective, designable characteristics), along with a five-dimensional environmental framework. This contribution positions environmental quality as the primary lever for sustainable organizational performance while respecting human dignity, laying the groundwork for more comprehensive theoretical elaboration in subsequent work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出组织科学的范式转变：从关注个体责任转向系统优化组织环境。引入HOWAR©公式C=f(I,A)，通过个体身份(I)与组织环境(A)的动态交互理解组织行为，区分组织氛围（主观感知）与组织环境（客观可设计特征），建立五维环境框架，将环境质量作为可持续组织绩效的主要杠杆。
AI.research_question: 如何通过系统优化组织环境而非仅仅关注个体责任来实现可持续的组织绩效？
AI.motivation: 基于多年应用经验和初步文献回顾，认识到传统组织科学过度强调个体责任，需要范式转变，将焦点转向组织环境的系统优化，以更有效地提升组织绩效并尊重人的尊严。
AI.theoretical_framework: HOWAR©公式C=f(I,A)作为核心理论框架，其中C代表组织行为/结果，I代表个体身份，A代表组织环境。区分组织气候（主观感知）与组织环境（客观可设计特征），并提出五维环境框架。
AI.method: 基于多年应用经验和初步文献回顾的理论构建方法，提出概念框架和公式，建立理论模型。
AI.findings: 提出了组织科学的范式转变框架，建立了HOWAR©公式，明确了组织环境与组织气候的区别，构建了五维环境框架，将环境质量确立为可持续组织绩效的主要杠杆。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出组织科学的范式转变；2. 引入HOWAR©公式C=f(I,A)作为新概念基础；3. 明确区分组织气候与组织环境；4. 建立五维环境框架；5. 为后续理论发展奠定基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理者提供了系统优化组织环境的理论指导，将环境质量作为提升绩效的主要杠杆，同时尊重人的尊严，为组织设计和改进提供实践框架。

title: Naor Revisited: Two-Sided Queues with Strategic Agents
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, Carnegie Mellon University, David A. Tepper School of Business, University of Michigan at Ann Arbor,  and University of Michigan at Ann Arbor - Department of Industrial and Operations Engineering

detail.title: Naor Revisited: Two-Sided Queues with Strategic Agents
detail.abstract: We study a two-sided observable queue where strategic agents arrive on each side according to a Poisson process, seeking to match. Agents decide to join or balk by weighing their matching reward against their expected delay cost until matching. This setting generalizes the seminal one-sided queueing model of Naor (1969) while fundamentally changing the incentive structure: each agent creates both a negative same-side externality and a positive opposite-side externality. We establish the following main results on the equilibrium joining thresholds and performance under self-optimization, social welfare optimization, and profit maximization. (1) These regimes balance the thresholds on both sides in contrasting ways. The self-optimizing thresholds ignore the opposite side's reward and delay cost. The socially optimal thresholds imply that each side's probability of immediate matching is proportional to its delay cost, a newsvendor-like solution. In stark contrast, profit-maximization yields a one-sided queue. (2) Self-optimization may lead to inefficient underjoining, not only on one side, but also in aggregate, yielding lower throughput than socially optimal. However, social optimization may hurt the welfare of one side, compared to self-optimization, pointing to efficiency-equity trade-offs. (3) Social optimization can be implemented via side-specific prices that may require a subsidy on one side, yet guarantee non-negative revenue. (4) The Price of Anarchy (ratio of optimal welfare to self-optimizing welfare) is unbounded and highly sensitive to arrival-rate asymmetries. (5) Profit maximization yields lower throughput than socially optimal, yet the Price of Profit (ratio of optimal welfare to profit-maximizing welfare) is bounded by a factor of 2.

AI.tldr: 研究双边可观察队列中策略性代理的匹配决策，分析自优化、社会福利优化和利润最大化三种机制下的均衡阈值和性能表现，揭示双边外部性带来的激励结构变化。
AI.research_question: 在双边可观察队列中，策略性代理如何做出加入/退出决策？自优化、社会福利优化和利润最大化三种机制下的均衡阈值和性能表现有何差异？
AI.motivation: 将Naor(1969)的单边排队模型扩展到双边匹配场景，研究双边外部性（同边负外部性和对边正外部性）如何改变激励结构，为双边匹配平台提供理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排队博弈理论、双边匹配理论、外部性理论、策略性排队行为、机制设计理论。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，使用泊松过程描述双边到达，建立均衡阈值模型，比较自优化、社会福利优化和利润最大化三种机制下的均衡解。
AI.findings: 1) 三种机制以不同方式平衡双边阈值；2) 自优化可能导致双边低效加入不足；3) 社会福利优化可通过双边定价实现；4) 无政府价格无界且对到达率不对称敏感；5) 利润最大化导致单边队列，利润价格有界于2。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展Naor模型到双边匹配场景；2) 揭示双边外部性对激励结构的影响；3) 建立三种机制下的均衡阈值理论；4) 分析效率-公平权衡；5) 量化无政府价格和利润价格。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为双边匹配平台提供定价策略指导；2) 揭示社会福利优化可能需要单边补贴；3) 帮助平台设计兼顾效率和公平的机制；4) 为监管政策提供理论依据。

title: IoT Enable Smart Heath ATM and Selecting the Optimal Location using Minimal Vertex Cover
affiliations: University of Science and Technology Meghalaya

detail.title: IoT Enable Smart Heath ATM and Selecting the Optimal Location using Minimal Vertex Cover
detail.abstract: Objective Health ATMs are touch-operated machines that use sensors to measure test readings and provides test results instantly. They also successfully create and store health records of patients. They allow patients to check and access their health records anytime with the help of the Internet. These health ATMs have medical devices embedded in them that conduct various tests and research. Method We have design an IoT based smart Health ATMs for Smart Cit. There will be multiple Health ATMs positioned throughout the city; these Health ATMs will be set up with low-cost embedded device, which helps in tracking the status of Health ATMs vacant or full along with location tracking module to get the real-time location of Health ATMs. In this system, Health ATMs are not eventually distributed so that maximum people get the benefit from the Health ATMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于物联网的智能健康ATM系统，通过在城市中部署配备低成本嵌入式设备的健康ATM，实现实时状态监控和位置追踪，优化设备分布以最大化服务覆盖。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个基于物联网的智能健康ATM系统，通过优化设备分布和实时监控来提高城市居民的健康服务可及性？
AI.motivation: 传统健康ATM系统缺乏实时监控和优化分布机制，导致服务效率不高。需要一种智能化的解决方案来改善健康ATM的可用性和覆盖范围。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物联网技术、嵌入式系统、位置服务、优化分布理论、智能城市基础设施。
AI.method: 设计基于物联网的智能健康ATM系统，配备低成本嵌入式设备，包含状态监控模块（空闲/繁忙）和位置追踪模块，通过优化分布算法确保设备覆盖最大化。
AI.findings: 提出的系统能够实时监控健康ATM状态和位置，通过优化分布使更多居民受益，提高了健康服务的可及性和效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了物联网在医疗健康领域的应用理论，提出了智能健康ATM系统的优化分布框架，为智能城市健康基础设施提供了理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可实际部署的智能健康ATM系统原型，提供了低成本解决方案，有助于改善城市居民的健康监测便利性，为公共卫生管理提供技术支持。

title: The Social Ponzi: A Cognitive Autopsy of the 'Bad Actor'

detail.title: The Social Ponzi: A Cognitive Autopsy of the 'Bad Actor'
detail.abstract: This paper applies a cognitive-behavioral framework to the Zachary Horwitz fraud case, popularly known through the documentary Bad Actor. Rather than treating the fraud as a product of individual pathology or greed, the analysis reframes it as a socially seeded narrative system driven by identity uncertainty, perception management, and Justified Irrational Rationalization (JIRP). The framework generates testable predictions regarding social origin, communicative framing, narrative escalation, and fear hierarchy. Comparison with the public record confirms core predictions while revealing specific informational blind spots-termed Target Variables-that existing accounts do not resolve. The paper demonstrates how cognitive frameworks can function as forensic tools for auditing narrative-driven systems.

AI.tldr: 本文运用认知行为框架分析Zachary Horwitz欺诈案，将欺诈重新定义为由身份不确定性、感知管理和合理化驱动的社会叙事系统，而非个人病理或贪婪。该框架生成可检验的预测，并与公开记录对比验证。
AI.research_question: 认知行为框架如何解释Zachary Horwitz欺诈案中的叙事驱动系统？
AI.motivation: 传统上欺诈被归因于个人病理或贪婪，但本文认为需要更系统的社会认知框架来解释欺诈行为如何通过叙事系统维持和升级。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知行为框架，重点关注身份不确定性、感知管理、合理化机制（JIRP）以及社会叙事系统理论。
AI.method: 应用认知行为框架分析Zachary Horwitz欺诈案（Bad Actor纪录片案例），与公开记录进行对比验证，识别信息盲点（目标变量）。
AI.findings: 框架的核心预测得到公开记录确认，同时揭示了现有解释未能解决的具体信息盲点（目标变量）。欺诈行为确实遵循身份不确定性驱动的叙事系统模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出认知框架可作为审计叙事驱动系统的法证工具，发展了欺诈行为的系统化社会认知解释理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欺诈调查和预防提供新的分析工具，帮助识别叙事系统中的关键盲点和风险点，提高欺诈检测能力。

title: Indebted Supply and Monetary Policy: A Theory of Financial Dominance
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, Sciences Po and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Indebted Supply and Monetary Policy: A Theory of Financial Dominance
detail.abstract: We develop a New Keynesian model with financial frictions to study how corporate capital structure shapes static and dynamic monetary policy tradeoffs through the supply side. Ex post, when corporate leverage is high, monetary tightening contracts both demand and supply. As a result, the Phillips curve is highly non-linear and state-dependent, and the "natural rate" Rn ensuring price stability increases with corporate leverage. Yet the tradeoff between in inflation targeting and tightening supply constraints implies that the optimal ex-post policy is to set a rate Ropt < Rn that can decrease with leverage. Ex ante, firms' market-timing incentives lead them to increase leverage when rates are low, which creates an intertemporal tradeoff: monetary easing supports current demand but hurts future supply, which makes easing partially self-defeating. The optimal ex-ante monetary policy features a prudential motive for leaning against leverage even when the divine coincidence holds in the current period.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含金融摩擦的新凯恩斯主义模型，研究企业资本结构如何通过供给侧影响货币政策的静态和动态权衡。研究发现：高杠杆时，货币紧缩同时收缩需求和供给，导致菲利普斯曲线高度非线性和状态依赖；最优货币政策需要权衡通胀目标和供给约束；低利率会激励企业增加杠杆，形成跨期权衡——宽松政策支持当前需求但损害未来供给。
AI.research_question: 企业资本结构如何通过供给侧渠道影响货币政策的静态和动态权衡？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策分析主要关注需求侧，忽略了企业资本结构通过供给侧渠道对货币政策传导的影响。特别是在高杠杆环境下，货币政策对供给侧的冲击可能产生重要的非线性和跨期效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义模型结合金融摩擦理论，特别关注企业资本结构（杠杆率）在货币政策传导中的作用，分析供给侧渠道如何影响菲利普斯曲线和自然利率。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建包含金融摩擦的新凯恩斯主义动态随机一般均衡模型，分析企业杠杆率如何内生决定并影响货币政策传导机制。
AI.findings: 1. 高杠杆时货币紧缩同时收缩需求和供给，导致菲利普斯曲线高度非线性和状态依赖；2. 确保价格稳定的"自然利率"随企业杠杆率上升而提高；3. 最优事后政策利率低于自然利率，且可能随杠杆率下降；4. 低利率激励企业增加杠杆，形成跨期权衡；5. 最优事前货币政策包含审慎动机，即使当期存在"神圣巧合"。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将企业资本结构纳入新凯恩斯主义货币政策分析框架；2. 揭示了供给侧渠道在货币政策传导中的重要作用；3. 提出了货币政策在金融稳定方面的审慎动机理论依据；4. 发展了状态依赖的菲利普斯曲线理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行在高杠杆环境下制定货币政策提供理论指导；2. 强调了货币政策需要考虑金融稳定目标；3. 为宏观审慎政策与货币政策的协调配合提供分析框架；4. 有助于理解低利率环境下的政策困境和跨期权衡。

title: Methodological Variation in Empirical Asset Pricing
affiliations: Saarland University, University of Reading - ICMA Centre and Leibniz  Universität Hannover - Faculty of Economics and Management

detail.title: Methodological Variation in Empirical Asset Pricing
detail.abstract: Empirical asset pricing research exhibits substantial methodological heterogeneity. Analyzing 386 published studies, we document that researchers face over 51,840 unique design-choice combinations in data handling, portfolio sorting, and regression analysis. Key methodological choices vary substantially across studies and are often incompletely documented, complicating replication and comparison. Our empirical analysis demonstrates that methodological choices are systematically associated with reported t-statistics, with data source selection and winsorization of independent variables exhibiting the largest effects. Our results underscore the need for complete methodological disclosure, systematic robustness testing, and standardized reporting to enhance credibility and facilitate cumulative knowledge building in empirical asset pricing.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了386篇实证资产定价研究，发现研究者面临超过51,840种独特的设计选择组合。方法论选择差异大且文档不完整，影响研究的可复制性和可比性。研究发现方法论选择与报告的t统计量系统性相关，其中数据源选择和独立变量缩尾处理影响最大。
AI.research_question: 实证资产定价研究中的方法论异质性如何影响研究结果的可信度和可比性？具体而言，不同的设计选择如何影响报告的统计显著性？
AI.motivation: 实证资产定价研究存在显著的方法论异质性，但缺乏对这种异质性程度及其对研究结果影响的系统性分析。方法论选择的不完整文档记录阻碍了研究的复制和比较，影响了该领域的知识积累。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于研究透明度、可复制性和方法论稳健性理论框架，探讨实证研究设计中多重选择对结果的影响。
AI.method: 对386篇已发表实证资产定价研究进行系统性分析，量化数据处理、投资组合排序和回归分析中的设计选择组合，并检验这些选择与报告统计显著性之间的关联。
AI.findings: 1. 研究者面临超过51,840种独特的设计选择组合；2. 关键方法论选择在不同研究中差异显著且文档不完整；3. 方法论选择与报告的t统计量系统性相关，数据源选择和独立变量缩尾处理影响最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化实证资产定价研究的方法论异质性，揭示了设计选择对统计结果的系统性影响，为研究透明度和方法论稳健性理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调完整方法论披露的必要性，提倡系统性稳健性测试和标准化报告，以增强实证资产定价研究的可信度并促进知识的累积性建设。

title: Islam, Politics, and Women in the Public Sphere: Between Institutions, Movements, and Practices
affiliations: Institute for Advanced Study in Toulouse (IAST), Toulouse School of Economics

detail.title: Islam, Politics, and Women in the Public Sphere: Between Institutions, Movements, and Practices
detail.abstract: Bridging interpretive and quantitative research approaches, this chapter synthesizes interdisciplinary discussions of three interrelated inquiries. First, how have major political turning points recast debates about Islam and women’s public roles? Second, how does Islam shape women’s prospects for public participation, whether through state laws and reforms, Islamist parties and movements, or religious practices and interpretations? Third, what does the recent turn to quantitative methods in the study of Islam add to longer-standing debates, and how might it be put into dialogue with qualitative and interpretive approaches?

AI.tldr: 本章通过跨学科视角，综合探讨了伊斯兰教与女性公共角色的三个核心问题：政治转折点如何重塑相关辩论、伊斯兰教如何影响女性公共参与、以及定量方法如何补充传统定性研究。
AI.research_question:
1. 重大政治转折点如何重塑关于伊斯兰教与女性公共角色的辩论？
2. 伊斯兰教如何通过国家法律改革、伊斯兰主义政党运动、宗教实践和解释来塑造女性公共参与的前景？
3. 伊斯兰研究中的定量方法转向对长期存在的辩论有何贡献？如何与定性和解释性方法进行对话？
AI.motivation: 弥合解释性研究和定量研究方法之间的鸿沟，整合跨学科讨论，为理解伊斯兰教与女性公共角色的复杂关系提供更全面的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨学科理论框架，结合政治学、社会学、性别研究和宗教研究，融合解释性方法和定量方法，探讨伊斯兰教与女性公共参与的多维度关系。
AI.method: 综合文献综述和跨学科分析方法，整合解释性研究和定量研究，通过三个相互关联的探究问题构建分析框架。
AI.findings:
1. 政治转折点显著重塑了关于伊斯兰教与女性公共角色的辩论框架和焦点
2. 伊斯兰教通过多重机制影响女性公共参与，包括制度性、政治性和宗教文化层面
3. 定量方法为传统定性研究提供了补充视角，两者结合能产生更丰富的分析洞见
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了连接解释性和定量研究方法的桥梁框架
2. 发展了跨学科分析伊斯兰教与女性公共角色的理论视角
3. 为方法论整合提供了理论依据和实践路径
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了理解伊斯兰教与女性公共参与关系的多维视角
2. 为研究者提供了整合不同研究方法的实践指南
3. 为伊斯兰社会中的女性赋权和公共参与提供了分析工具

title: Endogenous Formation of Production Networks with Imperfect Information
affiliations: Université Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne, Climate Finance Alpha

detail.title: Endogenous Formation of Production Networks with Imperfect Information
detail.abstract: We provide a model of the formation of production networks with imperfect information. We consider firms that sequentially explore their local network in search of productivity enhancing technologies. We show that this exploration process generates a Markov process over production networks that converges to equilibrium networks whose structure is determined by the search radius of firms, which we use as a measure of innovativeness. In this setting, we investigate how the structure of equilibrium networks vary with information diffusion and, conversely, how the structure of production networks influence the diffusion of innovations. On the one hand, our model predicts that with increasing information diffusion, production networks become more connected and that their degree distribution shifts to the right. On the second hand, our model provides micro-foundations for the analysis of innovation diffusion as a percolation process. We provide a characterisation of a percolation threshold in terms of the spectral radius, show that technological adoption rates will be suboptimal in general, and that the capacity of an economy to adopt innovations decreases with the percolation threshold. Overall, our model replicates a number of stylized facts of the empirical literature on the diffusion of innovation and provides new testable implications linking the topology of production networks with innovativeness.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个信息不完全下的生产网络形成模型，企业通过局部网络搜索提升生产率的技术。模型显示搜索过程生成马尔可夫过程，收敛到均衡网络结构由企业搜索半径（创新性度量）决定。研究信息扩散如何影响网络结构，以及网络结构如何影响创新扩散。
AI.research_question: 信息不完全条件下生产网络如何形成？网络结构如何影响创新扩散？信息扩散又如何影响生产网络结构？
AI.motivation: 理解生产网络形成机制及其与创新扩散的相互作用，为创新扩散的渗流过程分析提供微观基础，解释实证文献中的典型事实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全信息下的生产网络形成理论、马尔可夫过程、渗流理论、谱半径分析、创新扩散理论。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建企业通过局部网络搜索技术的序列探索模型，分析生成的马尔可夫过程及其均衡网络结构。
AI.findings: 1. 信息扩散增加使生产网络更连接，度分布右移；2. 创新扩散可建模为渗流过程，用谱半径刻画渗流阈值；3. 技术采用率通常次优；4. 经济采纳创新能力随渗流阈值增加而下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为不完全信息下的生产网络形成提供理论模型；2. 为创新扩散的渗流过程分析提供微观基础；3. 建立网络拓扑结构与创新性的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释创新扩散的实证典型事实；2. 提供可检验的预测：网络拓扑与创新性的关系；3. 为政策制定者理解创新扩散机制提供理论依据。

title: Triangular Pure Parity Deviations
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, Johannes Kepler University Linz - Department of Economics and BI Norwegian Business School

detail.title: Triangular Pure Parity Deviations
detail.abstract: We develop a triangular arbitrage methodology to decompose cross-currency basis spreads into two distinct components: currency-specific term funding premium differentials and bilateral pure parity deviations. Using data from seven major currencies spanning 2002-2024, we find that pure parity deviations, which are genuine violations of triangular no-arbitrage, remain economically minimal (under 5 basis points) even during crisis periods, suggesting that international cross-currency markets maintain high efficiency. Term funding premium differentials account for 97-99% of observed bases, reflecting the compensation required for bearing term funding risk across different currencies. We validate this interpretation using cross-currency bond bases constructed from matched-issuer bonds, finding that bond bases net of pure parity closely track swap term funding premium differentials. Since bond yields necessarily embed term funding premia, this convergence confirms our identification. Our results indicate that apparent CIP violations primarily reflect domestic funding market conditions rather than international arbitrage failures. Only the 2022 SOFR transition temporarily disrupted this pattern, creating meaningful pure parity deviations in swap markets that quickly reverted. Our decomposition provides a diagnostic tool distinguishing between domestic funding constraints and bilateral frictions, with distinct policy implications for each component.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一种三角套利方法，将跨货币基差分解为两个独立成分：货币特定的期限融资溢价差异和双边纯平价偏差。研究发现，真正的无套利条件违反（纯平价偏差）即使在危机期间也保持在5个基点以下，表明国际跨货币市场保持高效。观察到的基差97-99%来自期限融资溢价差异，反映了承担不同货币期限融资风险所需的补偿。
AI.research_question: 跨货币基差（cross-currency basis spreads）在多大程度上反映了真正的无套利条件违反（纯平价偏差），而不是期限融资溢价差异？如何区分这两种成分？
AI.motivation: 传统上，跨货币基差被视为抛补利率平价（CIP）的违反，但作者认为这可能错误地将期限融资溢价差异解释为套利失败。需要一种方法来区分真正的无套利条件违反与不同货币期限融资风险的补偿差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抛补利率平价（CIP）理论、三角套利原理、期限结构理论、融资风险溢价理论。论文基于三角无套利条件构建分析框架，将基差分解为两个理论成分。
AI.method: 开发三角套利方法，使用2002-2024年七种主要货币的数据，将跨货币基差分解为货币特定的期限融资溢价差异和双边纯平价偏差。使用匹配发行人债券构建的跨货币债券基差进行验证。
AI.findings: 1. 纯平价偏差（真正的无套利违反）即使在危机期间也保持在5个基点以下，表明国际跨货币市场保持高效。2. 期限融资溢价差异占观察到的基差的97-99%，反映了承担不同货币期限融资风险所需的补偿。3. 债券基差减去纯平价成分后与互换期限融资溢价差异高度相关，验证了分解的有效性。4. 2022年SOFR过渡期暂时破坏了这一模式，在互换市场产生了有意义的纯平价偏差，但很快恢复。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了将跨货币基差分解为期限融资溢价差异和纯平价偏差的理论框架。2. 澄清了抛补利率平价违反的本质，表明大多数观察到的基差反映的是融资市场条件而非套利失败。3. 建立了三角套利方法作为诊断工具，区分国内融资约束和双边摩擦。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供诊断工具，区分国内融资约束（期限融资溢价差异）和国际套利摩擦（纯平价偏差）。2. 帮助市场参与者更好地理解跨货币基差的驱动因素。3. 揭示了2022年SOFR过渡对跨货币市场的暂时性影响。4. 表明国际跨货币市场在正常和危机期间都保持高效，减少了政策干预的必要性。

title: Do Minorities Pay More to Avoid Flood Risk?

detail.title: Do Minorities Pay More to Avoid Flood Risk?
detail.abstract: Black and Hispanic homebuyers pay 3% more than white buyers for equivalent housing outside flood zones but only 1% more inside flood zones. Using 26M repeatsales transactions (2000-2020) and plausibly exogenous flood zone changes, I show that racial price differentials vary systematically with flood risk. Where flood risk is most salient, premiums for safe housing reach 5% for minority buyers. In highrisk counties, Black and Hispanic buyers pay double the premium white buyers pay for safe housing. As climate change expands flood zones, access to safe housing for minorities may be further restricted, reinforcing inequality and environmental injustice.

AI.tldr: 黑人及西班牙裔购房者在非洪水区比白人购房者多支付3%的房价，但在洪水区内仅多支付1%。洪水风险显著影响种族价格差异，在风险最高地区，少数族裔为安全住房支付的溢价可达5%。随着气候变化扩大洪水区，少数族裔获得安全住房的机会可能进一步受限，加剧不平等和环境不公。
AI.research_question: 洪水风险如何影响不同种族购房者的房价差异？随着气候变化扩大洪水区，这对少数族裔获得安全住房的机会有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究种族住房价格差异与环境风险（特别是洪水风险）之间的相互作用，揭示气候变化如何加剧住房不平等和环境不公问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境正义理论、住房市场歧视理论、风险认知理论、气候变化与不平等交叉理论
AI.method: 使用2000-2020年间2600万次重复销售交易数据，采用准自然实验方法，利用外生洪水区变化来识别因果关系。
AI.findings: 1. 黑人及西班牙裔购房者在非洪水区比白人购房者多支付3%的房价，但在洪水区内仅多支付1%。2. 种族价格差异随洪水风险系统性变化。3. 在洪水风险最显著地区，少数族裔为安全住房支付的溢价可达5%。4. 在高风险县，黑人及西班牙裔购房者为安全住房支付的溢价是白人的两倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将环境风险纳入种族住房价格差异分析框架。2. 揭示洪水风险如何调节种族住房溢价。3. 建立气候变化、住房不平等和环境不公之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供气候变化加剧住房不平等的证据。2. 帮助识别需要干预的高风险地区。3. 为环境正义倡导提供实证支持。4. 警示气候变化可能进一步限制少数族裔获得安全住房的机会。

title: Public Good or Public Bad? Nation-building and Indigenous Institutions
affiliations: Queen's University Belfast, University of Cologne, Instituto Tecnologico y de Estudios Superiores de Monterrey (ITESM) and Cardiff University

detail.title: Public Good or Public Bad? Nation-building and Indigenous Institutions
detail.abstract: While existing evidence shows that nation-building policies unify societies, little is known about how and what makes some societal groups to resist them. We examine this in the context of the post-Mexican Revolution (1920s-1950s), when the new state implemented a nation-building policy to eliminate Indigenous cultures and identities by increasing connectivity via transport infrastructure. In a difference-in-differences design, we leverage heterogeneity in the exposure to pre-colonial political centralisation as a proxy for the ability of Indigenous populations in mobilising to resist national integration. We find that the expansion of transport infrastructure was lower in municipalities with a stronger efficacy of Indigenous mobilisation. We demonstrate that this underprovision of public goods can be partly explained by Indigenous identity preservation and high abilities for collective actions.

AI.tldr: 墨西哥革命后，国家推行民族建设政策，通过交通基础设施消除原住民文化。研究发现，原住民动员能力强的地区交通基础设施扩张较少，这源于原住民身份保护和集体行动能力。
AI.research_question: 为什么某些社会群体会抵制民族建设政策？在墨西哥革命后的民族建设背景下，原住民动员能力如何影响交通基础设施的扩张？
AI.motivation: 现有研究显示民族建设政策能统一社会，但缺乏对某些群体抵制这些政策的原因和机制的理解。墨西哥革命后国家试图通过交通基础设施消除原住民文化的背景提供了研究这一问题的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民族建设理论、集体行动理论、原住民动员能力理论、公共物品供给理论
AI.method: 采用双重差分设计，利用前殖民时期政治集中度的异质性作为原住民动员能力的代理变量，分析其对交通基础设施扩张的影响。
AI.findings: 原住民动员能力较强的市镇交通基础设施扩张较少。这种公共物品供给不足部分源于原住民身份保护和较高的集体行动能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了民族建设政策可能遇到的抵制机制；2) 将原住民动员能力与公共物品供给联系起来；3) 扩展了集体行动理论在民族建设背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者理解民族建设政策的实施障碍提供参考；2) 强调在推进国家一体化时需要考虑原住民群体的动员能力和文化保护需求；3) 对公共物品分配不均的机制提供解释。

title: Sharpe Proportionality in S&P 500 Buy-Write Strategies: A One-Month Rolling Analysis

detail.title: Sharpe Proportionality in S&P 500 Buy-Write Strategies: A One-Month Rolling Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper provides empirical evidence that the Sharpe ratio of an S&P 500-based Buy-Write strategy exhibits a stable proportional relationship with the Sharpe ratio of its underlying equity index. Extending prior work based on twelve-month rolling windows, this study conducts a onemonth rolling analysis using daily data from January 2008 to December 2025. We find that Buy-Write Sharpe ratios scale linearly with the Sharpe ratios of the underlying index through the origin, with a high degree of explanatory power. When market conditions are classified by excess return and volatility regimes, the proportionality coefficient adjusts systematically across regimes, while the proportional structure itself remains intact. These findings indicate that Sharpe Proportionality is not a long-horizon averaging artifact but a structural feature observable at short time scales. The results are interpreted as empirical evidence for the Risk-Proportionality Principle (RPP), suggesting that Sharpe ratios function as a fundamental unit of risk-adjusted performance transmission in option-based strategies.

AI.tldr: 研究发现S&P 500买入-卖出策略的夏普比率与其基础股指的夏普比率存在稳定的比例关系，这种关系在不同市场条件下保持结构稳定，支持风险比例原则。
AI.research_question: 买入-卖出策略的夏普比率是否与其基础股指的夏普比率存在稳定的比例关系？这种关系是否在不同市场条件下保持结构稳定？
AI.motivation: 先前研究基于12个月滚动窗口发现了夏普比例关系，但需要验证这是否是长期平均效应，还是在短期时间尺度上也能观察到的结构特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险比例原则(RPP)，认为夏普比率是风险调整绩效传递的基本单位，特别是在期权策略中。
AI.method: 使用2008年1月至2025年12月的日度数据进行一个月滚动分析，将市场条件按超额收益和波动率制度分类，检验比例系数在不同制度下的系统性调整。
AI.findings: 买入-卖出策略的夏普比率与基础股指的夏普比率存在线性比例关系，且通过原点，解释力强。比例系数在不同市场制度下系统性调整，但比例结构本身保持不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明夏普比例性不是长期平均效应，而是可在短期时间尺度观察到的结构特征，为风险比例原则提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了理解和预测期权策略风险调整绩效的框架，帮助在不同市场条件下评估买入-卖出策略的表现。

title: Submission: Select Committee on the Operation of the Capital Gains Tax Discount
affiliations: University of New South Wales (UNSW), UNSW Business School

detail.title: Submission: Select Committee on the Operation of the Capital Gains Tax Discount
detail.abstract:
This submission makes recommendations that are designed to be at least revenue neutral over the long term and ensure and ensure budget sustainability. The overarching crux of the submission is that increasing capital taxes creates a significant risk of capital flight to 0% CGT regimes, including New Zealand. This, almost tautologically, would also involve the person leaving to that foreign jurisdiction, also decreasing income tax. Not only that, foreign capital would be deterred, undermining growth. Higher CGT would also create frictions in the market, reducing transaction frequency. This would reduce tax revenue and would stop capital from going to its most efficient use.

This submission is grounded in the idea that Australia should grow the economic pie and the tax base, rather than merely seek to divide a stagnant economic pie. This means that reducing tax rates can increase tax revenue, as the submission explains below. This operates by attracting, and retaining capital and labor. By contrast, increasing tax rates can reduce total tax revenue. This is because higher tax rates deter new capital from arriving, and cause existing capital to leave, thereby reducing the total tax take. AI.tldr: 该论文认为提高资本利得税会导致资本外流到低税率国家，减少投资交易，最终降低税收收入，建议通过降低税率来吸引资本和劳动力，扩大税基。
AI.research_question: 提高资本利得税对澳大利亚经济、资本流动和税收收入有何影响？如何通过税收政策优化来促进经济增长和预算可持续性？
AI.motivation: 澳大利亚面临税收政策选择：是提高资本利得税来增加短期收入，还是通过降低税率来吸引资本和劳动力，扩大经济规模和税基。论文关注高税率可能导致资本外流、投资减少和税收收入下降的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于拉弗曲线理论（降低税率可能增加税收收入）、资本流动理论（资本会流向税率较低的地区）、税收竞争理论（国家间税收政策相互影响）和经济增长理论（税收政策对投资和经济增长的影响）。
AI.method: 政策分析论文，基于理论论证和逻辑推理，分析资本利得税提高可能带来的经济后果，包括资本外流、投资减少、交易频率下降等机制。
AI.findings: 提高资本利得税会导致：1）资本外流到零资本利得税国家（如新西兰）；2）高技能人才随资本外流；3）外国资本流入减少；4）市场交易摩擦增加；5）资本配置效率降低；6）最终税收收入可能下降而非增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）在澳大利亚税收政策背景下验证了拉弗曲线理论；2）阐明了资本利得税对资本流动和人才流动的联动效应；3）提出了税收政策对资本配置效率的影响机制；4）强调了税收竞争在国际资本流动中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为澳大利亚政府提供税收政策建议：降低税率以吸引资本和劳动力；2）提出确保长期预算可持续性的政策框架；3）警示提高资本利得税可能带来的经济风险；4）建议通过扩大经济规模而非仅重新分配来增加税收收入。

title: How Computational Complexity can Restore General Equilibrium in Markets with Indivisible Goods
affiliations: University of Cambridge, University of Cambridge, University of Cambridge - Faculty of Economics and University of Melbourne - Department of Finance

detail.title: How Computational Complexity can Restore General Equilibrium in Markets with Indivisible Goods
detail.abstract: We study market equilibrium in settings with indivisible goods and tight budget constraints, where a traditional Walrasian Equilibrium (WE) may fail to exist. We introduce the Complexity Compensating Equilibrium (CCE), in which prices endogenously render the budget problem computationally difficult. Complexity induces heterogeneous demands even among agents with homogeneous preferences, as individuals allocate varying levels of cognitive effort. We define the equilibrium region as the set of price configurations that satisfy the necessary economic and computational conditions for equilibrium to exist. In this region, price configurations maximize the difficulty of the budget problem in addition to satisfying market clearing conditions. We evaluate the predictions of CCE through a controlled market experiment. We find that trading prices consistently force the budget problem to the equilibrium region. Further supporting and central to the CCE framework, the equilibrium bundles of goods generate markedly different utility levels across agents. This outcome contradicts a core feature of WE, namely, the equalization of utilities. In a setting where it exists, we reject WE on both prices and utilities, in favor of CCE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出复杂性补偿均衡（CCE）作为传统瓦尔拉斯均衡（WE）在不可分割商品和紧预算约束下的替代方案。CCE中价格内生地使预算问题计算困难，导致即使偏好相同的个体也产生异质需求。实验证据支持CCE，拒绝WE。
AI.research_question: 在不可分割商品和紧预算约束的市场中，当传统瓦尔拉斯均衡不存在时，是否存在一种考虑计算复杂性的均衡概念？这种均衡如何影响价格形成和个体效用分配？
AI.motivation: 传统瓦尔拉斯均衡在不可分割商品和紧预算约束的市场中可能不存在，需要新的均衡概念。现实市场中个体面临计算复杂性，这可能影响决策和均衡结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂性补偿均衡（CCE）框架，结合计算复杂性理论和市场均衡理论。均衡区域定义为满足经济和计算条件的价格配置集合，其中价格最大化预算问题的难度。
AI.method: 理论建模结合受控市场实验。理论部分定义CCE概念和均衡区域；实验部分通过实际交易检验CCE预测。
AI.findings: 交易价格始终将预算问题推向均衡区域；均衡商品束在不同个体间产生显著不同的效用水平，这与瓦尔拉斯均衡的效用均等化特征相矛盾；在存在WE的情况下，实验数据拒绝WE而支持CCE。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出CCE作为传统WE的替代均衡概念；将计算复杂性内生化为价格形成机制；定义均衡区域概念；证明即使偏好相同的个体也会因计算努力差异而产生异质需求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不可分割商品市场提供更现实的均衡分析框架；解释现实市场中观察到的效用差异现象；为市场设计和政策制定提供新视角。

title: Budget Implementation and Economic Growth: A Neo-Classical Approach to Developing Economies
affiliations: Institute of Management and Technology (IMT), Enugu

detail.title: Budget Implementation and Economic Growth: A Neo-Classical Approach to Developing Economies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based entirely on secondary data obtained from publicly available and credible sources, including central bank of Nigeria, World Bank, National Bureau of Statistics, published academic articles, etc.. No human participants or personally identifiable information were involved in the research. As such, ethical approval and informed consent were not required. The research has adhered to all standard ethical guidelines for secondary data analysis, including proper citation, data integrity, and compliance with relevant copyright and data usage policies.
declarations.funderStatement: Self

detail.abstract: Effective government budget implementation is crucial to accelerating economic growth in any nation. This study examined the impact of government budget implementation on Nigeria's economic growth from 1981 and 2023 using the neoclassical growth theory. After controlling for inflation (INF) and exchange rates (EXR), it looked at the effects of public debt servicing (PDS), capital expenditure (CAPEX), and recurrent spending (REX) on GDP growth. An autoregressive (AR) model, diagnostic tests, SWOT and PESTEL analyses, time series data from the Central Bank of Nigeria Statistical Bulletin, and World Bank indicators were all used in the study. According to the results, CAPEX (p = 0.979), REX (p = 0.915), and PDS (p = 0.940) were not statistically significant on their own, while the AR (1) term was highly significant (p = 0.002). 37% of the variation in GDP growth was explained by the entire model, which was significant at the 1% level (F-statistic p = 0.009). Economic, institutional, and technological issues impacting budget implementation were further highlighted using SWOT and PESTEL analyses. To promote sustainable economic growth, the study recommends giving priority to profitable capital projects, streamlining ongoing spending, reorganizing debt obligations, and improving budget transparency and participatory monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用新古典增长理论，分析了1981-2023年间尼日利亚政府预算执行对经济增长的影响。研究发现资本支出、经常性支出和公共债务偿还对GDP增长无显著影响，而自回归项显著。研究建议优先考虑盈利性资本项目、优化经常性支出、重组债务并加强预算透明度。
AI.research_question: 政府预算执行对尼日利亚经济增长有何影响？具体而言，公共债务偿还、资本支出和经常性支出如何影响GDP增长？
AI.motivation: 有效的政府预算执行对任何国家的经济增长都至关重要。尼日利亚作为发展中经济体，需要了解其预算执行对经济增长的具体影响，以制定更有效的财政政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新古典增长理论，该理论强调资本积累、技术进步和劳动力增长对经济增长的决定性作用。
AI.method: 使用自回归模型、诊断检验、SWOT和PESTEL分析，数据来源于尼日利亚中央银行统计公报和世界银行指标的时间序列数据（1981-2023年）。
AI.findings: 资本支出、经常性支出和公共债务偿还在统计上均不显著，而AR(1)项高度显著。整个模型解释了37%的GDP增长变异，在1%水平上显著。SWOT和PESTEL分析进一步揭示了影响预算执行的经济、制度和技术问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将新古典增长理论应用于尼日利亚的预算执行分析，为理解发展中经济体的财政政策与经济增长关系提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议优先考虑盈利性资本项目、优化经常性支出、重组债务义务、加强预算透明度和参与式监督，以促进可持续经济增长。

title: The Green Inflation Hump: Synthesizing Greenflation, Fossilflation, and Deflationary Dividends in a Non-linear Green Transition Model

detail.title: The Green Inflation Hump: Synthesizing Greenflation, Fossilflation, and Deflationary Dividends in a Non-linear Green Transition Model
detail.abstract: Current ecological macroeconomic literature on the inflationary effect of climate change and the green transition is often polarized between narratives of "Fossilflation" (driven by carbon pricing) and "Greenflation" (driven by mineral and supply chain bottlenecks). This paper argues that standard linear models fail to integrate these dynamics, treating them as conflicting outcomes rather than sequential phases. We propose a methodological synthesis using a dynamic simulation of the Eurozone transition. By modeling green investments as an exponential forcing function against systemic rigidities (𝜒 =22), we identify a "Green Inflation Hump", a non-linear price trajectory with a short to medium term increase and a medium to long-term decrease in overall inflation. Simulating four pathways, we demonstrate a critical policy paradox: attempting to avoid the transition friction of "Greenflation" (via Stagnation) traps the economy in a high-inflation spiral of "Fossilflation," reaching 5.4% by 2040. In contrast, even a "Crash Program" generates a manageable inflation spike (peaking at 2.97%) before delivering deep structural price stability (1.2%).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"绿色通胀驼峰"概念，认为绿色转型会经历先通胀后通缩的非线性价格轨迹，试图避免转型摩擦反而会导致更高的化石燃料通胀。
AI.research_question: 气候转型如何影响通胀动态？是否存在避免"化石通胀"和"绿色通胀"两难的政策路径？
AI.motivation: 现有生态宏观经济文献对气候变化的通胀效应存在两极分化观点，要么关注碳定价导致的"化石通胀"，要么关注绿色转型瓶颈导致的"绿色通胀"，缺乏整合分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态宏观经济学、非线性系统动力学、转型经济学、绿色投资作为指数型强迫函数对抗系统刚性
AI.method: 使用欧元区转型动态模拟，将绿色投资建模为对抗系统刚性的指数型强迫函数(𝜒=22)，模拟四种转型路径
AI.findings: 发现"绿色通胀驼峰"现象：短期到中期通胀上升，中期到长期通胀下降；试图避免转型摩擦会导致更高的化石燃料通胀(2040年达5.4%)；而"紧急计划"路径仅产生可控的通胀峰值(2.97%)后实现深度结构性价格稳定(1.2%)
AI.theory_contributions: 提出整合"化石通胀"和"绿色通胀"的动态框架，引入"绿色通胀驼峰"概念，揭示气候转型的非线性通胀轨迹
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供转型路径选择依据：接受短期可控的绿色通胀比试图避免转型摩擦更优，能实现长期价格稳定

title: AI-Powered Recruitment in Startups: Leveraging HR Analytics for Smart Hiring

detail.title: AI-Powered Recruitment in Startups: Leveraging HR Analytics for Smart Hiring
detail.abstract: This chapter explores the rise of AI-powered recruitment and its implications for startups. It is organized into six sections. After the introduction, the second section examines the drivers behind the shift from traditional recruitment methods to AI-enabled approaches. The third section discusses how AI technologies are being applied in recruitment, highlighting their functionalities and impacts. The fourth section presents two real-world cases demonstrating how startups have successfully integrated AI-powered tools into their hiring processes. The five section considers the potential pitfalls of AI in recruitment, including algorithmic bias, data privacy concerns, and the continuing importance of human judgment in hiring decisions. The final section discusses policy implications and directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨AI招聘的兴起及其对初创企业的影响，分析驱动因素、应用方式、实际案例、潜在风险和政策启示。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的招聘如何影响初创企业的招聘实践？其驱动因素、应用方式、实际效果、潜在风险和政策启示是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在招聘领域的广泛应用，初创企业面临从传统招聘向AI驱动招聘的转型，需要理解这一趋势的驱动因素、实际应用和潜在挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、人力资源管理理论、算法决策理论、组织变革理论
AI.method: 文献综述与案例分析相结合的方法，包括两个初创企业的实际案例研究
AI.findings: 1. 技术效率需求和数据驱动决策是主要驱动因素；2. AI在简历筛选、候选人匹配等方面有广泛应用；3. 初创企业成功整合AI工具可提高招聘效率；4. 存在算法偏见、数据隐私等风险；5. 人机协作是关键成功因素
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建AI招聘在初创企业环境中的理论框架；2. 拓展技术采纳理论在人力资源管理中的应用；3. 深化对算法决策与人类判断互补性的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为初创企业提供AI招聘实施指南；2. 识别并规避AI招聘的潜在风险；3. 提出人机协作的最佳实践；4. 为政策制定者提供监管建议
