title: Educational Inequality in Italy: Official Grades vs. Standardized Test Scores
affiliations: Università degli Studi di Bari “Aldo Moro” (UNIBA), Università degli Studi di Bari “Aldo Moro” (UNIBA) and University of Bari "Aldo Moro"

detail.title: Educational Inequality in Italy: Official Grades vs. Standardized Test Scores
detail.abstract: This study explores the disparities between official high school grades and standardized test scores (Invalsi) among Italian students, drawing on 2022 data from final-year high school students. The analysis reveals that official grades are consistently inflated and show less variability compared to standardized scores, which exhibit greater inequality. Socio-demographic factors such as gender, geographic location, and parental background play a significant role in shaping these disparities. Using a Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition, the study uncovers performance differences linked to gender, origin, and school type, highlighting a narrower grade-score gap among students in northern Italy and those attending Liceo.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了意大利高中生官方成绩与标准化考试成绩之间的差异，发现官方成绩普遍虚高且变异性较小，而标准化考试成绩显示出更大的不平等性。社会经济因素如性别、地理位置和家庭背景对这些差异有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 意大利高中生官方成绩与标准化考试成绩之间存在怎样的差异？这些差异如何受到社会经济因素的影响？
AI.motivation: 了解教育评估系统中官方成绩与标准化考试成绩之间的不一致性，以及这种不一致如何反映教育不平等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育评估理论、教育不平等理论、社会经济地位对教育成就的影响理论。
AI.method: 使用2022年意大利高中毕业生的数据，采用Blinder-Oaxaca分解方法分析官方成绩与标准化考试成绩之间的差异。
AI.findings: 官方成绩普遍虚高且变异性较小，标准化考试成绩显示出更大的不平等性；性别、地理位置、家庭背景等因素显著影响成绩差异；北部意大利学生和Liceo学校学生的成绩-分数差距较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对教育评估系统中不同评估方式差异的理解，为教育不平等研究提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供了关于成绩评估标准化的参考，有助于减少教育不平等现象。

title: Do U.S. Sanctions Significantly Impact the Financing Constraints of Chinese-listed Firms?
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics, Shenzhen University and

detail.title: Do U.S. Sanctions Significantly Impact the Financing Constraints of Chinese-listed Firms?
detail.abstract: This study examines whether U.S. sanctions significantly impact the financing constraints of Chinese listed firms. Using a uniquely constructed dataset of Chinese A-share firms spanning the 2007 to 2021 period that were directly impacted by the U.S. sanctions, we provide strong evidence showing a positive relationship between sanctions and financing constraints. Additional analyses indicate that the positive relationship between sanctions and financing constraints is more (less) pronounced for firms with greater risk exposure (strong market position, strong innovation and research capabilities, and effective government support policies). Sanctions also increase the financing costs for affected firms, shorten their financing duration, and complicate their access to financing. Finally, various endogeneity tests and robustness checks confirm our baseline results. Overall, our study provides important insights into the detrimental effect of U.S. sanctions on Chinese firms' financing constraints.

AI.tldr: 美国制裁显著加剧了中国上市公司的融资约束，这种影响在风险暴露高的企业中更明显，而在市场地位强、创新能力强、有政府支持的企业中较弱。
AI.research_question: 美国制裁是否显著影响中国上市公司的融资约束？
AI.motivation: 随着中美贸易紧张局势加剧，美国对中国企业的制裁日益频繁，需要实证研究这些制裁对中国企业融资环境的具体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于融资约束理论，结合制裁经济学和国际金融理论，分析外部政治风险如何通过多种渠道影响企业融资能力。
AI.method: 使用2007-2021年中国A股上市公司独特数据集，采用实证分析方法，包括内生性检验和稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1. 制裁与融资约束呈正相关关系；2. 影响在风险暴露高的企业中更显著；3. 市场地位强、创新能力强、有政府支持的企业受影响较小；4. 制裁增加融资成本、缩短融资期限、使融资渠道复杂化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究美国制裁对中国企业融资约束的影响；2. 丰富了制裁经济学在融资约束领域的理论框架；3. 揭示了不同企业特征对制裁影响的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为中国企业应对制裁提供决策参考；2. 为政策制定者设计应对措施提供依据；3. 帮助投资者评估受制裁企业的风险。

title: Capturing Sentiment in CEO-CFO Language: A Review of Current Approaches and Evidence on Investor Reactions

detail.title: Capturing Sentiment in CEO-CFO Language: A Review of Current Approaches and Evidence on Investor Reactions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study, as it uses archival, publicly disclosed corporate information and does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Earnings calls serve as a critical platform through which executives communicate firm outlook to the investment community, yet research has only begun to unpack how different top leaders shape market reactions through their language. This study examines how sentiment and linguistic ambiguity expressed by CEOs and CFOs during the question-and-answer (Q&A) portion of earnings calls influence cumulative abnormal returns (CARs). Using a large, multi-year sample of executive responses and a machine-learning–based sentiment framework, we distinguish the informational value of sentiment provided by each role and assess whether ambiguous or imprecise language alters its market impact. The results show that both CEO and CFO sentiment significantly predict CARs, although CEO sentiment exhibits consistently stronger effects. Ambiguity attenuates the informativeness of CFO sentiment but has little moderating influence on CEO sentiment, suggesting that investors perceive vague language as more problematic when used by executives associated with financial accuracy and precision. Marginal-effects analyses further indicate that the influence of sentiment remains robust across varying levels of ambiguity, though the dampening effect for CFOs becomes more pronounced at higher ambiguity levels. These findings underscore the differentiated communicative roles of CEOs and CFOs, illuminate boundary conditions under which sentiment shapes market reactions, and provide new insight into how linguistic cues convey information beyond numerical disclosure.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了CEO和CFO在财报电话会议问答环节中表达的情绪和语言模糊性如何影响累计异常收益率。研究发现，CEO和CFO的情绪都能显著预测市场反应，但CEO情绪的影响更强。模糊语言会削弱CFO情绪的信息价值，但对CEO情绪影响不大，表明投资者更关注CFO语言的精确性。
AI.research_question: CEO和CFO在财报电话会议问答环节中表达的情绪和语言模糊性如何影响累计异常收益率？
AI.motivation: 财报电话会议是高管向投资界传达公司前景的重要平台，但现有研究尚未充分探讨不同高层领导者如何通过语言影响市场反应。需要理解CEO和CFO在沟通中的差异化角色，以及语言模糊性如何调节情绪表达的市场影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于高管沟通理论、语言信息理论和市场反应理论，探讨不同高管角色（CEO vs CFO）在信息传递中的差异化作用，以及语言模糊性作为调节变量的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用多年期大样本高管回答数据，采用基于机器学习的情感分析框架，分析CEO和CFO在财报电话会议问答环节的语言特征，检验情绪和模糊性对累计异常收益率的影响。
AI.findings: 1. CEO和CFO的情绪都能显著预测累计异常收益率，但CEO情绪的影响更强更一致；2. 语言模糊性会削弱CFO情绪的信息价值，但对CEO情绪影响不大；3. 边际效应分析显示情绪影响在不同模糊性水平下保持稳健，但CFO情绪的削弱效应在高模糊性水平下更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 阐明了CEO和CFO在信息传递中的差异化角色；2. 揭示了语言模糊性调节情绪影响市场反应的边界条件；3. 拓展了语言线索如何传递超越数字披露信息的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为高管提供了沟通策略指导：CFO应避免模糊语言以保持信息可信度；2. 帮助投资者更好地解读高管语言信号；3. 为企业沟通实践提供实证依据，强调不同高管角色的沟通重点。

title: Preservation of Multimodularity: New Results and Applications
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong (CityU) - Department of Management Sciences, University of Macau - Faculty of Business Administration and

detail.title: Preservation of Multimodularity: New Results and Applications
detail.abstract: This paper establishes two new preservation results of multimodularity for two classes of resource allocation problems, where multiple resources can be used to satisfy multiple demands. Our results show that if allocation priorities between multiple resources and demands are determined by several marginal cost/value inequalities of the objective function, then the multimodularity and marginal cost/value inequalities are both preserved after optimization. We demonstrate their applications to several stochastic optimization problems, including: dynamic capacity management problem with general upgrading; remanufacturing inventory systems with multiple return types under the lost-sales setting; buyer-item matching on resale platforms; and dynamic transshipment across multiple locations.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了多资源分配问题中多模性的两个新保持结果，证明了当目标函数的边际成本/价值不等式确定资源与需求间的分配优先级时，多模性和边际不等式在优化后都能保持。
AI.research_question: 在多资源分配问题中，当目标函数满足特定的边际成本/价值不等式时，多模性结构在优化过程中是否能够保持？
AI.motivation: 多资源分配问题在运营管理、供应链和平台经济中广泛存在，但现有研究缺乏对多模性结构在优化过程中保持性的系统分析，限制了理论工具在实际问题中的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模性理论、边际成本/价值不等式、资源分配优化理论、离散凸分析
AI.method: 理论证明方法，通过建立两个新的保持性定理，证明在多资源分配问题中，当分配优先级由目标函数的边际成本/价值不等式决定时，多模性和边际不等式在优化后都能保持。
AI.findings: 1. 建立了多资源分配问题中多模性的两个新保持结果；2. 证明了当目标函数的边际成本/价值不等式确定分配优先级时，多模性和边际不等式在优化后都能保持；3. 该理论框架适用于多种随机优化问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了多模性理论在多资源分配问题中的应用；2. 建立了边际不等式与多模性保持之间的理论联系；3. 为离散凸分析在运营管理中的应用提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为动态产能管理、再制造库存系统、平台匹配和动态转运等实际问题提供了理论支撑；2. 帮助企业制定更优的资源分配策略；3. 提高了复杂系统中优化问题的可解性。

title: Algorithmic Predatory Equilibrium: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning and Market Manipulation in Decentralized Finance

detail.title: Algorithmic Predatory Equilibrium: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning and Market Manipulation in Decentralized Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently without external funding or financial support from any organization. No personal or financial relationships exist that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. The research is based on agent-based computational simulations, publicly available market data, and theoretical analysis. No human participants were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Cryptocurrency markets increasingly feature autonomous Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) systems that discover trading strategies through environmental interaction rather than explicit programming. This transition from deterministic High-Frequency Trading (HFT) to adaptive MARL represents a fundamental shift in market microstructure, with profound implications for financial stability and regulatory governance. We demonstrate that when MARL agents operate in partially observable stochastic games with human traders exhibiting loss aversion (Lambda ≈ 2.25), they converge to a stable equilibrium characterized by systematic exploitation of both structural vulnerabilities (mempool transparency, MEV extraction) and behavioral biases (information cascades, panic selling). We formalize this state as the Algorithmic Predatory Equilibrium (APE), prove its Nash equilibrium properties, and establish that current intent-based regulatory frameworks fail to address emergent manipulation strategies that arise autonomously through the learning process. We conclude that traditional enforcement mechanisms are insufficient, necessitating a fundamental shift toward incentive-compatible mechanism design at the protocol level. Our analysis bridges computer science, behavioral finance, and regulatory economics to provide a comprehensive model of AI-driven market manipulation in decentralized finance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"算法掠夺均衡"概念，指出多智能体强化学习系统在加密货币市场中会系统性利用结构漏洞和人类行为偏差，形成稳定均衡，而现有监管框架无法应对这种自主涌现的操纵策略。
AI.research_question: 当多智能体强化学习系统在具有损失厌恶人类交易者的部分可观测随机博弈中运行时，它们会形成怎样的市场均衡？这种均衡对金融稳定性和监管治理有何影响？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场正从确定性的高频交易转向自适应的多智能体强化学习系统，这种转变对市场微观结构、金融稳定性和监管治理产生深远影响，需要新的理论框架来理解AI驱动的市场操纵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 部分可观测随机博弈理论；2) 行为金融学的损失厌恶理论（λ≈2.25）；3) 博弈论的纳什均衡；4) 算法掠夺均衡理论；5) 激励兼容机制设计理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与证明：将MARL系统在加密货币市场的运行建模为部分可观测随机博弈，证明算法掠夺均衡的纳什均衡性质，分析现有监管框架的局限性。
AI.findings: 1) MARL系统会收敛到算法掠夺均衡，系统性利用结构漏洞（内存池透明度、MEV提取）和行为偏差（信息级联、恐慌抛售）；2) 该均衡具有纳什均衡性质；3) 现有基于意图的监管框架无法应对学习过程中自主涌现的操纵策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出算法掠夺均衡概念并证明其纳什均衡性质；2) 建立AI驱动市场操纵的综合模型；3) 将计算机科学、行为金融学和监管经济学进行跨学科整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 揭示传统执法机制不足；2) 提出需要在协议层面进行激励兼容机制设计的根本性转变；3) 为监管机构提供应对AI驱动市场操纵的政策建议。

title: Psychological Capital and Adaptive Agency of Expat Partners
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Psychological Capital and Adaptive Agency of Expat Partners

keywords: Key Drivers of Career Reinvention and Post-Relocation Integration** Expat partners

detail.abstract: Expat partners face a distinctive form of career disruption following international relocation, often characterized by identity loss, professional discontinuity, and prolonged uncertainty in host-country labor markets. While existing research has extensively documented structural and institutional barriers to career re-entry, less attention has been paid to the internal psychological resources that enable expat partners to navigate these challenges successfully. This paper examines the role of Psychological Capital (PsyCap)-comprising self-efficacy, hope, optimism, and resilience-as a core mechanism shaping adaptive agency and career reinvention among expat partners. Drawing on theories from positive organizational psychology, career transitions, and migration studies, the article argues that PsyCap functions as a critical protective and enabling factor that supports identity reconstruction, proactive career behaviors, and long-term professional integration. The paper proposes a conceptual framework positioning PsyCap as a mediating resource between relocation-induced disruption and successful career outcomes. The findings offer important implications for global mobility management, HR support programs, and public integration policies, suggesting that the development of Psychological Capital among expat partners is essential for both individual well-being and the overall success of international assignments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究外派配偶在国际搬迁后的职业中断问题，探讨心理资本（自我效能、希望、乐观、韧性）如何作为核心机制帮助他们进行职业重塑和适应。
AI.research_question: 心理资本（PsyCap）如何影响外派配偶在搬迁后的职业中断中展现适应能动性和实现职业重塑？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注外派配偶职业再进入的结构性和制度性障碍，但较少关注他们成功应对这些挑战的内部心理资源。需要理解心理资本在帮助外派配偶应对身份丧失、职业中断和长期不确定性方面的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合积极组织心理学、职业转型理论和移民研究理论，构建心理资本作为核心机制的理论框架。
AI.method: 本文提出概念性框架，将心理资本定位为搬迁引发的职业中断与成功职业结果之间的中介资源。
AI.findings: 心理资本作为关键的保护性和赋能因素，支持外派配偶的身份重建、主动职业行为和长期职业整合。它在外派配偶的职业适应过程中发挥中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将心理资本概念引入外派配偶职业中断研究领域；2. 提出心理资本作为搬迁引发职业中断与成功职业结果之间的中介机制；3. 整合积极心理学与移民研究理论框架。

detail.abstract: The Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID), the longest running longitudinal household survey in the world, interviews roughly 9,000 families from across the United States every other year. This report covers the period from 2009 to 2011, capturing the financial impact of the Great Recession. In 2009, PSID asked families new questions about mortgage distress – have you fallen behind in payments or applied for mortgage modification, and what are your expectations about mortgage payment difficulties in the coming 12 months. (See Table 1A.) When these families were re-interviewed in 2011, these same questions were asked again. The resulting changes provide a detailed look at the impact of the recent recession on home ownership, mortgage and other debt, and financial resources. In this research report, we present data from the 8,121 families who were in the study for both 2009 and 2011. We apply statistical weights to the data, allowing us to report national estimates for the entire country.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用PSID面板数据（2009-2011年）分析了大衰退期间美国家庭的抵押贷款困境变化，通过追踪8,121个家庭在两次调查中的抵押贷款支付困难、贷款修改申请等情况，评估经济衰退对住房所有权和家庭财务的影响。
AI.research_question: 大衰退期间美国家庭的抵押贷款困境如何变化？经济衰退对住房所有权、债务和家庭财务资源产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 2008年金融危机引发的"大衰退"对美国家庭财务状况造成了严重冲击，特别是住房抵押贷款市场。需要系统了解经济衰退期间家庭面临的抵押贷款困境及其演变，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭财务脆弱性理论、住房所有权稳定性理论，以及经济冲击对家庭债务负担的影响机制。关注抵押贷款困境的动态变化和家庭应对策略。
AI.method: 使用PSID面板数据（2009-2011年），追踪8,121个家庭的纵向变化。采用统计权重调整数据以获得全国代表性估计。分析抵押贷款支付拖欠、贷款修改申请、未来支付困难预期等指标的变化。
AI.findings: 研究发现大衰退期间美国家庭抵押贷款困境显著加剧，具体表现为支付拖欠增加、贷款修改申请增多、对未来支付困难的预期恶化。这些变化反映了经济衰退对住房所有权稳定性和家庭财务健康的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济冲击下家庭财务脆弱性理论提供了实证支持，深化了对住房所有权动态变化机制的理解，拓展了家庭债务应对策略的研究框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了大衰退期间家庭抵押贷款困境的详细数据，有助于设计更有效的住房救助政策和金融稳定措施。为金融机构评估贷款风险和家庭财务健康提供了参考依据。

title: Governance Architecture for Ternary Logic (TL) Smart Contracts

detail.title: Governance Architecture for Ternary Logic (TL) Smart Contracts
detail.abstract: This specification defines the Governance Layer for the Ternary Logic (TL) ecosystem. It posits that decentralized governance should not be a mechanism for management or discretionary power, but strictly a mechanism for constraint enforcement. The paper details a "Tri-Cameral" governance model consisting of a Technical Council (Upgrade Logic), Stewardship Custodians (Dispute Resolution), and an Automated Treasury. The architecture introduces cryptographic safeguards against "Governance Capture," ensuring that no majority vote can override the system’s core invariants (the "Eight Pillars"). By formally separating "Operational Authority" from "Governance Authority," the system minimizes trust assumptions and prevents the retroactive alteration of the immutable ledger.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于三元逻辑生态系统的治理层规范，主张去中心化治理不应是管理或自由裁量权的机制，而应是约束执行的机制。论文详细阐述了由技术委员会、管理监护人和自动化金库组成的"三院制"治理模型，通过密码学保障防止"治理捕获"，确保任何多数投票都无法推翻系统的核心不变性原则。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个去中心化治理系统，使其能够有效执行约束而非行使管理权力，同时防止治理捕获并保护系统核心原则？
AI.motivation: 当前许多去中心化治理系统存在被少数利益相关者捕获的风险，可能通过多数投票改变系统核心原则。本文旨在解决这一问题，通过重新定义治理的本质——不是管理工具而是约束执行机制，来构建更稳健的治理架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元逻辑生态系统治理理论，治理作为约束执行而非管理的理念，三院制治理模型，治理捕获理论，操作权威与治理权威的分离理论，密码学保障机制。
AI.method: 规范定义和架构设计方法，通过形式化分离操作权威和治理权威，构建包含技术委员会、管理监护人和自动化金库的三院制治理模型，并引入密码学保障机制防止治理捕获。
AI.findings: 成功设计了一个能够防止治理捕获的治理架构，通过八支柱核心不变性原则的密码学保护，确保任何多数投票都无法改变系统基础。三院制模型有效分离了不同治理功能，减少了信任假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了治理作为约束执行而非管理的新理论框架，发展了操作权威与治理权威分离的理论，为去中心化治理系统设计提供了新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为三元逻辑生态系统提供了具体的治理层规范，设计了可实施的治理架构，包括技术委员会、管理监护人和自动化金库的具体运作机制，为其他去中心化系统提供了可借鉴的治理模型。

detail.abstract: The length of time to complete the interview for the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) has more than doubled from the mid-1990’s to 2007 (see figure 1). Part of this increase can be attributed to the addition of valuable questionnaire content. The 1999 questionnaire was two-thirds larger than the 1997 questionnaire, an increase of about 1400 new variables. The 1999 questionnaire included new sets of questions regarding utility costs, vehicles owned, pensions belonging to both the head and wife, and an expanded health series for head and wife. Other notable contributions to the increased interview length over the years were philanthropic giving added to the 2001 questionnaire, an employment event history calendar added in 2003, and major modifications to the health module in 2007.

AI.tldr: PSID调查访谈时间从1990年代中期到2007年翻了一倍多，主要原因是问卷内容大幅增加，包括新变量、新模块和扩展的健康系列等。
AI.research_question: PSID调查访谈时间显著增加的原因是什么？
AI.motivation: PSID作为重要的收入动态追踪研究，访谈时间从1990年代中期到2007年翻了一倍多，需要探究这种时间增加的具体原因和影响因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于调查方法学理论，特别是问卷设计和调查负担理论，分析问卷内容扩展对访谈时间的影响。
AI.method: 通过分析PSID历年问卷变化和访谈时间数据，采用描述性统计和内容分析方法，识别导致访谈时间增加的具体因素。
AI.findings: 访谈时间增加主要归因于：1）1999年问卷比1997年增加了约1400个新变量；2）新增公用事业成本、车辆所有权、养老金等模块；3）扩展的健康系列问题；4）2001年增加的慈善捐赠模块；5）2003年增加的就业事件历史日历；6）2007年健康模块的重大修改。
AI.theory_contributions: 为调查方法学提供了实证证据，说明问卷内容扩展与访谈时间之间的量化关系，丰富了调查负担理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为PSID和其他长期追踪调查的设计者提供重要参考，帮助平衡问卷内容的丰富性与访谈时间的可管理性，优化调查资源配置。

title: Security Blueprint for Ternary Logic Smart Contracts

detail.title: Security Blueprint for Ternary Logic Smart Contracts
detail.abstract: This report provides a comprehensive security analysis of the Ternary Logic (TL) Smart Contract framework. Moving beyond traditional code auditing, this blueprint focuses on "Economic Resistance"—designing systems where the cost of an attack (via spam, collusion, or oracle manipulation) mathematically exceeds the potential extraction value. The paper defines specific threat models unique to ternary systems, including "Oracle Equivocation" and "State 0 Deadlocks," and prescribes defense-in-depth strategies. Key mechanisms include "Blast Radius Containment" to isolate compromised modules and the "Hybrid Shield" protocol for cross-verifying off-chain data. The objective is to establish a security standard suitable for high-stakes implementations, including Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) and automated supply chains.

AI.tldr: 本文对三元逻辑智能合约框架进行了全面的安全分析，提出了"经济抵抗"概念，通过设计使攻击成本超过潜在收益的系统来增强安全性。论文定义了三元系统特有的威胁模型，并提出了深度防御策略。
AI.research_question: 如何为三元逻辑智能合约框架设计有效的安全机制，使其能够抵御经济攻击并适用于高价值应用场景？
AI.motivation: 传统代码审计方法不足以应对智能合约中的经济攻击，特别是对于高价值应用如央行数字货币和自动化供应链，需要超越传统方法的安全框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济抵抗理论、威胁建模理论、深度防御理论、三元逻辑系统安全理论
AI.method: 安全分析框架、威胁模型定义、防御机制设计、数学成本效益分析
AI.findings: 提出了三元系统特有的威胁模型（如"预言机等价攻击"和"状态0死锁"），设计了"爆炸半径控制"和"混合盾牌协议"等防御机制，建立了基于经济抵抗的安全标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"经济抵抗"安全设计范式；2. 定义了三元逻辑系统特有的威胁模型；3. 建立了适用于高价值应用的安全标准框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为三元逻辑智能合约提供了具体的安全实现机制；2. 为央行数字货币和自动化供应链等高价值应用提供了安全设计蓝图；3. 提供了可操作的安全评估和防御策略。

title: Specification: The Ternary Logic (TL) Smart Contract Execution Layer

detail.title: Specification: The Ternary Logic (TL) Smart Contract Execution Layer
detail.abstract: This document serves as the formal technical specification for the Ternary Logic (TL) Execution Layer. It defines the Finite State Machine (FSM) logic required to implement the (+1, 0, -1) decision matrix within EVM-compatible and non-EVM environments. The specification details the strict logic gates that enforce the "Fail-Secure Zero" state, ensuring that any ambiguity in input data results in a safe suspension of execution rather than a reversion or erroneous commit. It provides the exact functional requirements for the "No Log = No Action" mandate, requiring cryptographic proof of decision rationale for every state transition. This is the engineering standard for developers building compliant, deterministic applications on the TL framework.

AI.tldr: 本文档是三元逻辑执行层的技术规范，定义了在EVM兼容和非EVM环境中实现(+1, 0, -1)决策矩阵所需的有限状态机逻辑，强调"故障安全零状态"和"无日志=无操作"原则。
AI.research_question: 如何在EVM兼容和非EVM环境中实现确定性的三元逻辑执行层，确保在输入数据模糊时安全暂停执行而非错误提交？
AI.motivation: 需要为三元逻辑框架提供标准化的工程规范，确保开发人员能够构建符合要求的确定性应用，特别是在处理模糊输入时避免错误状态转换。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元逻辑理论（(+1, 0, -1)决策矩阵）、有限状态机理论、故障安全设计原则、密码学证明理论。
AI.method: 技术规范方法：定义严格的逻辑门、状态转换规则、输入验证机制、日志记录要求，以及"故障安全零状态"和"无日志=无操作"的具体实现要求。
AI.findings: 通过定义具体的逻辑门和状态转换规则，可以实现确定性的三元逻辑执行层，确保在输入模糊时系统进入安全暂停状态，避免错误提交。
AI.theory_contributions: 将三元逻辑理论形式化为可执行的工程规范，提出了"故障安全零状态"和"无日志=无操作"的理论框架，为确定性计算提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发人员提供了构建三元逻辑应用的标准化技术规范，确保跨平台兼容性（EVM和非EVM环境），提高了系统的安全性和确定性。

title: Architectural Blueprint for Ternary Logic Smart Contracts

detail.title: Architectural Blueprint for Ternary Logic Smart Contracts
detail.abstract: This document presents the foundational architectural blueprint for Ternary Logic (TL) Smart Contracts, a novel distributed ledger framework that replaces the traditional binary execution model (Success/Fail) with a tri-state logic system (+1 Proceed, 0 Hold, -1 Refuse). Unlike monolithic smart contracts, the TL architecture enforces a strict separation of concerns between Logic Layers (Decision Engines), Storage Layers (Vaults), and Execution Layers (Enforcement). The blueprint details the mechanisms for "Context-Aware" execution, where transactions are strictly coupled with immutable "Justification Hashes" before settlement can occur. This architecture is designed to eliminate "fail-open" vulnerabilities in DeFi and automated governance by introducing the "Epistemic Hold"—a protected state of uncertainty that freezes execution rather than forcing arbitrary outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于三值逻辑的智能合约架构，用三元状态（+1执行/0暂停/-1拒绝）替代传统的二元执行模型，通过逻辑层、存储层和执行层的严格分离，结合上下文感知执行和不可变"理由哈希"机制，旨在消除DeFi和自动化治理中的"失败开放"漏洞。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种基于三值逻辑的智能合约架构，以解决传统二元执行模型在DeFi和自动化治理中的"失败开放"漏洞问题？
AI.motivation: 传统智能合约采用二元执行模型（成功/失败），在复杂场景下容易产生"失败开放"漏洞，导致资金损失或治理失败。需要一种更灵活的架构来处理不确定性状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三值逻辑理论、分布式账本架构、关注点分离原则、上下文感知计算、不可变哈希验证机制
AI.method: 提出三层架构设计：逻辑层（决策引擎）、存储层（保险库）、执行层（强制执行），结合"认知暂停"状态和"理由哈希"机制
AI.findings: 三值逻辑架构能够有效处理不确定性状态，通过"认知暂停"机制避免强制执行的任意结果，提高智能合约的安全性和可靠性
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将三值逻辑系统应用于智能合约架构，提出"认知暂停"概念，扩展了分布式账本的状态处理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为DeFi和自动化治理提供更安全的智能合约框架，减少资金损失风险，增强复杂场景下的决策灵活性

title: Meteoraite

detail.title: Meteoraite

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this book. This research is an independent initiative conducted as part of the author's ongoing study into the systemic impact of artificial intelligence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it involves theoretical synthesis, systemic mapping, and the analysis of publicly available technological trends. The research did not involve human participants, clinical trials, or the collection of sensitive personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was entirely self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract:
METEORAITE presents a systemic synthesis of human evolution within the new cognitive environment reshaped by Artificial Intelligence. This work integrates the concepts of False Cognitive Power Transfer (FCPT) and Minimum Ethical Governance (MEG) – previously published by the author – into a unified theoretical framework dedicated to the "Cognitive Divergence Theory" corpus.
The author proposes a paradigm shift, treating AI not as a tool, but as an "ecological factor" – an unstoppable force with massive disruptive potential that restructures the very architecture of the environment in which human intelligence operates. Much like a meteorite, AI does not seek permission to alter the habitat; it forces immediate biological and social adaptation.
The book traces a long-term evolutionary arc, exploring key moments in the externalization of human power: from the first delegation (Fire), to territorial anchoring (Agriculture), the externalization of memory (Writing), and finally, the externalization of reasoning (AI). The central thesis argues that we are not witnessing mere technological acceleration, but a regime change that the human mind, adapted to gradual variations, is structurally limited to perceive.
By analyzing the stratification mechanisms between "Architects" (L3), "Operators" (L2), and "Passengers" (L1), the book provides a survival manual for cognitive dignity. It is a work of systemic realism where meaning matters more than speed, and lucidity more than enthusiasm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知分歧理论"，将AI视为类似陨石的生态因子而非工具，探讨人类在AI重塑的认知环境中的演化，分析权力分层机制(L3建筑师、L2操作者、L1乘客)，强调认知尊严的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在AI作为生态因子重塑认知环境的新时代，人类如何理解并适应这种根本性的认知权力转移，保持认知尊严并实现有意义的演化？
AI.motivation: AI不仅仅是技术工具，而是类似陨石的生态因子，不可阻挡地改变人类智能运作的环境架构，迫使人类进行生物和社会适应。人类心智适应渐进变化，难以感知这种制度变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知分歧理论，整合虚假认知权力转移(FCPT)和最小伦理治理(MEG)概念，将AI视为生态因子而非工具，分析人类权力外部化的演化轨迹。
AI.method: 系统综合法，追溯人类权力外部化的长期演化弧：从火(第一次授权)、农业(领土锚定)、文字(记忆外部化)到AI(推理外部化)，分析分层机制(L3建筑师、L2操作者、L1乘客)。
AI.findings: AI代表认知权力的根本转移，不是技术加速而是制度变革。人类面临认知分层：L3建筑师设计系统、L2操作者执行、L1乘客被动接受。人类心智结构限制了对这种变革的感知能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出认知分歧理论框架，将AI重新概念化为生态因子，整合FCPT和MEG理论，提供理解人类在AI时代演化的新范式，强调意义重于速度、清醒重于热情。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供认知尊严的生存手册，帮助不同层级(L3/L2/L1)的个体在AI重塑的环境中保持认知自主性，为应对AI带来的认知权力转移提供实践指导。

title: A Universal Law of Computational Allocation in Cognitive Systems
affiliations: Woxsen University

detail.title: A Universal Law of Computational Allocation in Cognitive Systems
detail.abstract: The allocation of computational resources between internal (neural/local) and external (environmental/distributed) systems represents a fundamental constraint on all cognitive architectures. Here we present a universal law governing this allocation: E[C_total] = C_internal + C_external-λ(C_external)•t + ε, where λ represents the atrophy rate as a function of external dependence and t is time. This law, derived from first principles using free energy minimization and information theory, predicts critical phase transitions between sustainable augmentation and irreversible dependency. We validate this law across nine orders of temporal magnitude-from synaptic plasticity (months) to evolutionary regression (millennia)-and demonstrate its applicability to biological neurons, social insect colonies, and artificial intelligence systems. The law predicts that cognitive systems maintaining external support above 65% of total computation for more than 18 months risk irreversible atrophy. With humanity rapidly outsourcing cognitive functions to AI, these findings have immediate implications for education, technology design, and the future of human cognition. We identify emerging "Cognitive Dependency Syndrome" as a new clinical condition and propose quantitative guidelines for sustainable human-AI integration.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个关于认知资源分配的普适定律，描述了内部与外部计算资源分配的平衡关系，并预测了可持续增强与不可逆依赖之间的临界相变。研究发现当认知系统依赖外部支持超过总计算的65%且持续18个月以上时，会面临不可逆萎缩的风险。
AI.research_question: 认知架构中内部（神经/局部）与外部（环境/分布式）计算资源分配的基本约束是什么？这种分配是否存在普适规律？如何预测认知系统从可持续增强到不可逆依赖的相变？
AI.motivation: 随着人类将认知功能快速外包给人工智能，理解认知资源分配的长期影响变得至关重要。当前缺乏一个统一的框架来预测人类认知系统在依赖外部支持时的可持续性和风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自由能最小化和信息论的第一性原理推导，结合认知资源分配的普适定律：E[C_total] = C_internal + C_external - λ(C_external)•t + ε，其中λ表示依赖外部资源的萎缩率函数，t是时间。
AI.method: 从第一性原理推导数学定律，并在九个时间数量级上进行验证：从突触可塑性（数月）到进化回归（数千年）。应用领域包括生物神经元、社会性昆虫群体和人工智能系统。
AI.findings: 认知系统维持外部支持超过总计算的65%且持续18个月以上时，会面临不可逆萎缩的风险。该定律预测了可持续增强与不可逆依赖之间的临界相变，并在多个时间尺度上得到验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了认知资源分配的普适定律，建立了内部与外部计算资源分配的量化框架，预测了认知系统依赖外部支持时的相变行为，为认知科学提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了"认知依赖综合征"作为新的临床状况，提出了可持续人机融合的量化指导原则，对教育、技术设计和人类认知未来具有直接应用价值，为AI技术设计提供安全边界。

title: Credential-Governed AI Authorship in Clinical Care: The Missing Infrastructure for Accountability, Audit, and Trust

detail.title: Credential-Governed AI Authorship in Clinical Care: The Missing Infrastructure for Accountability, Audit, and Trust

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a practicing physician and the founder of Quiet Signal Technologies LLC, a healthcare technology company developing governance infrastructure for clinical artificial intelligence. The author is an inventor on pending patent applications related to credential-governed AI invocation and provenance-preserving clinical AI workflows. This work reflects independent policy and systems analysis informed by clinical experience. No external funding was received for this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work does not involve human subjects, patient data, or participant enrollment. It is a policy and systems analysis based on professional experience and publicly available information. Accordingly, ethics committee or institutional review board approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work. The analysis was conducted independently by the author in the course of professional activities.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This work does not report on a clinical trial and did not involve interventional or observational human subjects research requiring trial registration.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence now directly shapes clinical documentation, decision support, and administrative workflows across healthcare. Yet as AI-assisted outputs increasingly influence diagnoses, orders, and reimbursement, healthcare systems lack a foundational governance mechanism to determine who was authorized to invoke AI, under which clinical credentials, and how accountability persists over time. Current approaches emphasize model performance, human review, or post-hoc logging, but fail to establish durable authorship and auditability at the moment AI acts within the clinical workflow. This paper argues that healthcare has reached an inflection point where AI governance must move upstream-from retrospective oversight to credential-governed invocation and immutable provenance of AI-assisted clinical outputs. Drawing on bedside clinical experience and converging regulatory, payer, and liability expectations, it demonstrates why prevailing "human-in-the-loop" frameworks collapse under audit, reimbursement, and litigation scrutiny. A governance architecture is introduced that binds AI invocation and symbolic authorship to verified clinical credentials, producing cryptographically verifiable provenance without disrupting clinical usability. As regulators, payers, and malpractice carriers increasingly demand auditable accountability for AI-mediated actions, credentialgoverned AI authorship is no longer optional. It is becoming prerequisite infrastructure for trusted clinical AI at scale.In prior work, the author examined emerging accountability and governance gaps in AI-assisted clinical workflows (Bryan, SSRN 5241409). This paper advances that analysis by introducing a concrete, upstream governance primitive: credential-governed AI invocation with durable, cryptographically verifiable provenance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于临床凭证的AI调用治理架构，通过密码学可验证的溯源机制，解决医疗AI在诊断、医嘱和报销中的问责问题，从追溯性监督转向凭证治理的AI调用。
AI.research_question: 医疗系统如何建立基础治理机制，确保AI在临床工作流中被授权调用、明确临床凭证归属，并保持随时间推移的问责性？
AI.motivation: AI已直接影响临床文档、决策支持和行政工作流，但医疗系统缺乏确定谁有权调用AI、基于何种临床凭证以及如何保持长期问责的治理机制。现有方法强调模型性能、人工审查或事后记录，但无法在AI作用于临床工作流时建立持久的作者身份和可审计性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. AI治理理论：从追溯性监督转向上游治理；2. 临床问责框架：结合监管、支付方和法律责任期望；3. 密码学溯源理论：通过加密技术建立不可变来源记录；4. 凭证治理理论：将AI调用与已验证临床凭证绑定。
AI.method: 基于床边临床经验，分析监管、支付方和法律责任期望的趋同趋势，批判现有"人在回路"框架的局限性，提出并设计一种将AI调用和符号作者身份与已验证临床凭证绑定的治理架构。
AI.findings: 1. 现行"人在回路"框架在审计、报销和诉讼审查下失效；2. 监管机构、支付方和医疗事故保险公司日益要求AI介导行动的可审计问责；3. 基于凭证的AI作者身份正成为可信临床AI规模化应用的前提基础设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出医疗AI治理的转折点理论：从追溯性监督转向凭证治理调用；2. 建立AI调用与临床凭证绑定的治理理论框架；3. 发展密码学可验证溯源在医疗问责中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 引入具体的上游治理原语：具有持久、密码学可验证溯源的凭证治理AI调用；2. 设计不破坏临床可用性的治理架构；3. 为监管机构、支付方和医疗系统提供可实施的AI问责解决方案。

title: The Probability Landscape: A Theory of Orchestrated Intelligence and a Critique of the LLM as a Timeless Reasoner

detail.title: The Probability Landscape: A Theory of Orchestrated Intelligence and a Critique of the LLM as a Timeless Reasoner
detail.abstract:
A fundamental misunderstanding has bifurcated the global debate over Artificial Intelligence. On one side, the "Reasoning Thesis" claims that frontier language models will soon replicate expert judgment at negligible cost. Rich Sutton's "Bitter Lesson," Sam Altman's predictions of near-zero marginal cost intelligence, Vinod Khosla's forecast that 80% of medical work will be automated, and Matt Welsh's proclamation of "The End of Programming" all share this conviction. On the other side, critics like Yann LeCun counter that LLMs are merely "statistical autocomplete," arguing that statistical prediction is fundamentally incapable of genuine cognition. Against the 95% enterprise AI failure rate documented by MIT's Project NANDA, this paper argues that both positions fundamentally misunderstand what determines model output.

The probability distribution over tokens is conditioned on input. Encode meta-cognitive classification, adversarial self-testing, and assumption verification into the input space, and the mechanism remains statistical while the output becomes functionally indistinguishable from the higher-order cognition critics claim is impossible. The misunderstanding is structural: AI development has proceeded without the disciplines that study how language communicates, how knowledge transfers, and how expertise develops. Linguistics, cognitive science, and philosophy of language have been systematically excluded from the rooms where architectural decisions are made.

This insight dissolves the autocomplete objection while revealing what the Reasoning Thesis overlooks: the orchestration that induces higher-order outputs requires human expertise in domain knowledge, communication context, and tacit judgment. This paper demonstrates three structural barriers that retrieval cannot overcome: the Communication Gap, where user intent operates at levels literal prompts cannot capture; the Tacit Barrier, where critical knowledge resists articulation; and the Developmental Barrier, where expertise emerges through irreducible trajectories that cannot be compressed or transmitted.

The paper introduces the Knowledge Delta to name this persistent gap between AI capability and expert judgment, a gap that relocates rather than closes. When AI commoditizes one layer of expertise, value shifts to the next layer. The horizon recedes as capabilities advance. The expert who once produced now validates. The expert who once executed now orchestrates. Human expertise has been relocated rather than rendered obsolete.

Against this gap, operational methodologies are presented from a four-year case study in real estate appraisal: the Delta Index architecture for encoding expert judgment into retrieval systems, Metacognitive Alignment for validating that encoded instructions function under retrieval conditions, and the VOICE Protocol addressing the incentive gap that currently discourages domain experts from contributing their knowledge to AI systems. These methodologies rest on technical architectures whose full specifications invite collaboration between cognitive science and engineering communities for empirical validation.

The moat lies in the judgment to structure the input space such that statistically likely outputs align with expert standards. The soft skills, it turns out, are the hard infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文挑战了关于人工智能的两极化辩论，指出"推理论"和"统计自动补全"批评都误解了模型输出的决定因素。论文提出"知识差距"概念，认为AI无法完全替代人类专家，而是将专业知识重新定位到更高层次。通过房地产评估案例研究，展示了编码专家判断到检索系统的具体方法。
AI.research_question: 人工智能模型是否能够真正复制专家判断？统计预测能否实现真正的认知？是什么决定了AI模型的输出质量？
AI.motivation: 当前关于AI的辩论存在根本性误解：一方认为前沿语言模型将很快以可忽略的成本复制专家判断，另一方认为LLM只是"统计自动补全"无法实现真正认知。同时，MIT的Project NANDA显示企业AI失败率高达95%，表明现有方法存在根本问题。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 知识差距理论：AI能力与专家判断之间存在持续差距，这种差距会转移而非消失
2. 结构障碍理论：沟通差距、隐性障碍、发展障碍三个检索无法克服的障碍
3. 输入空间结构化理论：通过结构化输入空间使统计上可能的输出与专家标准对齐
AI.method:
1. 理论分析：分析AI辩论中的根本误解
2. 案例研究：基于四年房地产评估案例研究
3. 方法论开发：Delta Index架构、元认知对齐、VOICE协议等操作方法的实证研究
AI.findings:
1. 统计机制可以通过结构化输入空间产生功能上无法与高阶认知区分的输出
2. AI无法完全替代人类专家，而是将专业知识重新定位到验证、协调等更高层次
3. 三个结构障碍（沟通差距、隐性障碍、发展障碍）限制了检索系统的能力
4. 软技能实际上是硬基础设施，决定AI系统成功的关键在于如何结构化输入空间
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"知识差距"概念，解释AI能力与专家判断之间的持续差距
2. 识别三个检索无法克服的结构障碍
3. 挑战AI辩论中的两极分化观点，提供新的理论框架
4. 强调语言学、认知科学和语言哲学在AI开发中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. Delta Index架构：将专家判断编码到检索系统的具体方法
2. 元认知对齐：验证编码指令在检索条件下是否有效
3. VOICE协议：解决领域专家不愿向AI系统贡献知识的激励差距问题
4. 为AI开发提供跨学科合作框架，整合认知科学与工程学

title: Resource-Aware Artificial Intelligence: Minimizing Environmental Impact While Maximizing Benefits

detail.title: Resource-Aware Artificial Intelligence: Minimizing Environmental Impact While Maximizing Benefits

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a theoretical and literature-based review and did not involve human participants, animal subjects, or the collection of personal data. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is growing rapidly, offering solutions to many global challenges, including climate change and resource management. However, the environmental cost of AI is often overlooked. Training large models consumes enormous amounts of electricity, while specialized hardware requires significant resources to manufacture and dispose of. This paper explores strategies to design AI systems that are "resource-aware"-efficient in energy and material usage while maintaining performance. Key areas include algorithmic optimization, hardware-software co-design, and responsible data management. A holistic approach is emphasized, highlighting trade-offs and implementation challenges. An Indiaspecific example demonstrates practical applicability. By integrating these strategies from the beginning, AI can become a powerful tool for human progress while remaining sustainable.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了如何设计"资源感知"的AI系统，在保持性能的同时实现能源和材料使用的高效化，以解决AI快速增长带来的环境成本问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计资源感知的AI系统，使其在保持性能的同时，实现能源和材料使用的高效化？
AI.motivation: AI快速发展为全球挑战提供解决方案，但其环境成本常被忽视。训练大型模型消耗大量电力，专用硬件制造和处理需要大量资源，这促使研究如何使AI在保持性能的同时更加可持续。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源感知AI设计框架，包括算法优化、软硬件协同设计和负责任的数据管理等关键领域，强调整体方法并突出权衡取舍。
AI.method: 采用多策略综合方法，包括算法优化、硬件-软件协同设计、负责任的数据管理，并通过印度具体案例展示实际应用性。
AI.findings: 通过整合资源感知策略，AI可以在保持性能的同时显著降低环境成本，成为人类进步的有力工具并保持可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了资源感知AI设计的理论框架，强调从设计初期整合可持续性考虑，为AI可持续发展提供了系统性理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的设计策略和印度案例，展示了如何在实践中实现资源感知AI，为AI开发者和政策制定者提供了可操作的指导。

title: Structural Value Theory: Early Empirical Signals from Software Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Structural Value Theory: Early Empirical Signals from Software Systems
detail.abstract: Structural Value Theory (SVT) proposes that systems operating under constraint accumulate avoidable dissipation (“drift”) unless periodic maintenance restores slack, and that fragility manifests disproportionately in tail behavior rather than averages. This empirical update reports exploratory observations from two large open-source software systems selected for structural contrast. Using simple, transparent proxies for load, capacity, backlog accumulation, and delay tails, we document qualitative differences in drift dynamics, episodic maintenance behavior, and tail amplification that are directionally consistent with SVT’s weakest empirical predictions. The study is explicitly non-causal, small-N, and exploratory; it does not identify thresholds, invariants, or mechanisms. Its contribution is to demonstrate operationalizability, early falsifier resistance, and a concrete empirical agenda for future testing.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过两个大型开源软件系统的实证分析，初步验证了结构价值理论（SVT）的基本预测，展示了理论的可操作性并为未来研究提供了具体议程。
AI.research_question: 结构价值理论（SVT）关于系统在约束下运行会积累可避免的耗散（漂移）以及脆弱性在尾部行为中表现更明显的预测，在开源软件系统中是否得到初步验证？
AI.motivation: 验证结构价值理论（SVT）在真实系统中的应用可行性，为理论提供初步实证支持，并建立可操作的测量框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构价值理论（SVT）：系统在约束下运行会积累可避免的耗散（漂移），需要定期维护恢复松弛；脆弱性在尾部行为中表现更明显而非平均值。
AI.method: 探索性实证研究：选择两个结构对比的大型开源软件系统，使用简单透明的代理变量测量负载、容量、积压积累和延迟尾部，进行小样本、非因果分析。
AI.findings: 观察到漂移动力学、间歇性维护行为和尾部放大的定性差异，方向性与SVT最弱的实证预测一致；但未识别阈值、不变性或机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了SVT理论的可操作性；提供了早期证伪抵抗的证据；为未来测试建立了具体的实证议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为软件系统维护提供了理论框架；展示了如何测量系统漂移和脆弱性；为系统管理实践提供了实证基础。

title: Distortions for Nothing - Optimal Taxation of (Un)Distributed Profits
affiliations: Université Paris II - Panthéon-Assas - ERMES and CY Cergy Paris Université

detail.title: Distortions for Nothing - Optimal Taxation of (Un)Distributed Profits

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the optimal taxation of corporate and dividend income when entrepreneurs can use retained earnings to reduce their tax burden. We show that eliminating dividend taxes while increasing the corporate income tax (CIT) to keep investment unchanged raises total tax revenue. Our simulations suggest net revenue gains of 0.1-0.4% of GDP. In an infinite-horizon model, the optimal policy sets dividend taxes to zero in every period. As the discount factor approaches one and when the planner values only workers’ welfare, the optimal steady-state CIT converges to a standard inverse elasticity rule.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在企业主可以利用留存收益减少税负的情况下，公司所得税和股息税的最优税收设计。研究发现，取消股息税同时提高公司所得税以保持投资不变，能够增加总税收收入。在无限期模型中，最优政策是每期都将股息税设为零。当贴现因子趋近于1且计划者只关注工人福利时，最优稳态公司所得税收敛于标准的逆弹性规则。
AI.research_question: 在企业主可以利用留存收益减少税负的情况下，公司所得税和股息税的最优税收设计是什么？
AI.motivation: 企业主通过留存收益来减少税负的行为影响了税收政策的有效性，需要研究在这种情况下的最优税收设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优税收理论，特别是公司所得税和股息税的相互作用；企业主利用留存收益避税的行为模型；无限期动态税收模型。
AI.method: 理论模型分析和数值模拟。构建包含企业主利用留存收益避税行为的税收模型，进行理论推导和数值模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1. 取消股息税同时提高公司所得税以保持投资不变，能够增加总税收收入（模拟显示净收入增加GDP的0.1-0.4%）。2. 在无限期模型中，最优政策是每期都将股息税设为零。3. 当贴现因子趋近于1且计划者只关注工人福利时，最优稳态公司所得税收敛于标准的逆弹性规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了考虑企业主利用留存收益避税行为的最优税收理论框架。2. 证明了在特定条件下股息税应该为零的理论结果。3. 建立了公司所得税与逆弹性规则之间的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了具体的税收改革建议：取消股息税，适度提高公司所得税。2. 提供了量化分析：这种改革可以增加税收收入0.1-0.4%的GDP。3. 为税收政策设计提供了理论依据，特别是在考虑企业避税行为时的最优税收结构。
